title.en: Volume 388 Biographies 147: Zhou Zhigao, Wang Xilu, Chen Liangyou, Li Hao, Chen Tuo, Hu Yi, Tang Wenruo, Li Dao
title.raw: 卷三百八十八 列傳第一百四十七 周執羔 王希呂 陳良祐 李浩 陳槖 胡沂 唐文若 李燾 Volume 388 Biographies 147: Zhou Zhigao, Wang Xilu, Chen Liangyou, Li Hao, Chen Tuo, Hu Yi, Tang Wenruo, Li Dao

sentences.zh: 周執羔

translations.literal: Zhou Zhigao
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Zhigao

sentences.zh: 周執羔，字表卿，信州弋陽人。

translations.literal: Zhou Zhigao, courtesy name Biaoqing, Xinzhou Yiyang person.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Zhigao, courtesy name Biaoqing, was a native of Yiyang in Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 宣和六年舉進士，廷試，徽宗擢為第二。

translations.literal: Xuanhe sixth year passed jinshi, palace examination, Huizong selected as second.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Xuanhe reign he passed the jinshi examination, and at the palace examination Emperor Huizong ranked him second.

sentences.zh: 授湖州司士曹事，俄除太學博士。

translations.literal: Appointed Huzhou Sishicao affair, soon removed Taixue boshi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Recorder of the Huzhou commandery staff, and soon thereafter was made an Erudite of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，乘輿南渡，自京師奔詣揚州，不及，遂從隆祐太后于江西，還覲會稽。

translations.literal: Jianyan beginning, imperial carriage south crossed, from capital rushed to Yangzhou, not reach, then followed Longyou Empress Dowager at Jiangxi, returned to audience Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jianyan era, when the imperial carriage crossed south, he rushed from the capital to reach Yangzhou but did not arrive in time; he therefore followed Empress Dowager Longyou into Jiangxi and later returned to attend the court at Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 尋以繼母劉疾，乞歸就養，調撫州宜黃縣丞。

translations.literal: Soon because stepmother Liu illness, requested return to care, transferred Fuzhou Yihuang county assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because his stepmother Lady Liu fell ill, he requested leave to return home and care for her and was transferred to the post of Assistant Magistrate of Yihuang County in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 時四境俶擾，潰卒相挻為變，令大恐，不知所為，執羔諭以禍福，皆斂手聽命。

translations.literal: Then four borders beginning disturbance, routed soldiers mutually incite as mutiny, magistrate greatly feared, not know what do, Zhigao instructed with fortune disaster, all folded hands listened orders.
translations.idiomatic: At the time unrest was breaking out on all sides, and routed soldiers were inciting one another to revolt. The magistrate was terrified and did not know what to do. Zhigao reasoned with them about reward and punishment, and they all submitted and obeyed.

sentences.zh: 既又訹其黨，執首謀者斬以徇。

translations.literal: Already again intimidated his faction, seized chief plotters beheaded to display.
translations.idiomatic: He then intimidated their followers, seized the ringleaders, and beheaded them as a public warning.

sentences.zh: 邑人德之，至繪像立祠。

translations.literal: District people appreciated him, to point painted portrait established shrine.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the district were grateful to him and even painted his portrait and erected a shrine.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，改秩，通判湖州。

translations.literal: Shaoxing fifth year, changed rank, vice commissioner Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Shaoxing reign his rank was adjusted and he was made Vice Commissioner of Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闋，通判平江府。

translations.literal: Completed mother mourning, mourning ended, vice commissioner Pingjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After completing mourning for his mother, he was made Vice Commissioner of Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 召為將作監丞。

translations.literal: Summoned as Jiangzuo jian cheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as Assistant Director of the Directorate of Works.

sentences.zh: 明年春，遷太常丞。

translations.literal: Next year spring, transferred Taichang cheng.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring he was promoted to Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 會始議建明堂，大樂久廢不修，詔奉常習肄之，訪輯舊聞，庀閱工器，製作始備。

translations.literal: Met beginning discuss build Bright Hall, great music long abandoned not repaired, edict Court of Imperial Sacrifices practice rehearse it, inquire compile old reports, prepare inspect tools implements, manufacture begin complete.
translations.idiomatic: At that time plans were first being discussed to build the Bright Hall. Court music had long been neglected and unrepaired. An edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to practice and rehearse it; old records were collected and researched, tools and instruments were prepared and inspected, and the production was at last put in order.

sentences.zh: 累遷右司員外郎。

translations.literal: Repeatedly transferred Right Department external vice director.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted, ultimately to External Vice Director of the Right Department.

sentences.zh: 八月，擢權禮部侍郎，充賀金生辰使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, promoted acting Ministry of Rites vice minister, filled congratulate Jin birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was promoted to Acting Vice Minister of Rites and appointed envoy to convey birthday congratulations to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 往歲奉使官得自辟其屬，賞典既厚，願行者多納金以請，執羔始拒絕之。

translations.literal: Previous years mission officials could self recruit subordinates, reward precedent already generous, willing goers many paid gold to request, Zhigao first refused it.
translations.idiomatic: In previous years envoys had been allowed to recruit their own staff, and since the rewards were generous, many who wished to join the mission had paid gold to obtain appointment. Zhigao was the first to refuse such payments.

sentences.zh: 使還，兼權吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Mission returned, concurrently acting Ministry of Personnel vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: After returning from his mission, he was concurrently appointed Acting Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 請賜新進士聞喜宴於禮部，從之。

translations.literal: Requested grant new jinshi Joyful News banquet at Ministry of Rites, followed it.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that newly minted jinshi be granted the Banquet of Joyful News at the Ministry of Rites, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 軍興廢此禮，至是乃復。

translations.literal: Military rise abandoned this rite, at this then restored.
translations.idiomatic: This ceremony had been abandoned when military campaigns began; only now was it restored.

sentences.zh: 同知貢舉。

translations.literal: Associate know tribute raising.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Associate Examiner for the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 舊例，進士試禮部下，歷十八年得免舉，又四試禮部下，始特奏名推恩。

translations.literal: Old precedent, jinshi tested Ministry of Rites subordinate, passed eighteen years obtain exempt examination, again four tests Ministry of Rites subordinate, then special memorial name extend grace.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old precedent, after jinshi had passed the metropolitan examination under the Ministry of Rites and served eighteen years, they could be exempt from re-examination; only after taking four examinations under the Ministry of Rites would they receive the special memorial name and related honors.

sentences.zh: 秦檜既以科第私其子，士論喧嘩，為減三年以悅眾。

translations.literal: Qin Hui already because examination degree favored his son, scholar opinion clamor, for reduced three years to please crowd.
translations.idiomatic: Since Qin Hui had used the examination system to favor his own son, scholarly opinion was in an uproar, and to appease the public the requirement was reduced by three years.

sentences.zh: 執羔言祖宗法不可亂，繇此忤檜，御史劾罷之。

translations.literal: Zhigao said ancestral temple law not can disorder, from this offended Hui, censor impeached dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhigao declared that the laws of the ancestors must not be disturbed. For this he offended Qin Hui, and a censor impeached him and had him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 又六年，起知眉州，徙閬州，又改夔州，兼夔路安撫使。

translations.literal: Again six years, raised know Meizhou, moved Langzhou, again changed Kuizhou, concurrently Kuilu pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Six years later he was reappointed Prefect of Meizhou, transferred to Langzhou, then reassigned to Kuizhou, concurrently serving as Pacification Commissioner of the Kuizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 夔部地接蠻獠，易以生事。

translations.literal: Kuizhou region land borders Man Liao, easy thereby cause trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuizhou region bordered the Man and Liao peoples and was prone to incidents.

sentences.zh: 或告溱、播夷叛，其豪帥請遣兵致討，執羔謂曰：「朝廷用爾為長，今一方繹騷，責將焉往，能盡力則貰爾，一兵不可得也。」

translations.literal: Someone reported Qin Bo Yi rebel, their powerful chiefs requested dispatch troops to attack, Zhigao said: "Court used you as chief, now one region continuous disturbance, blame will go where, can exert strength then pardon you, one soldier not obtainable also."
translations.idiomatic: When reports came that the Qin and Bo tribes had rebelled, their powerful chieftains asked that troops be sent to suppress them. Zhigao said to them: "The court appointed you as local leaders. Now that your region is in turmoil, where else can the blame fall? If you exert yourselves fully, you will be pardoned—but not one soldier will be sent.

sentences.zh: 豪懼，斬叛者以獻，夷人自是皆惕息。

translations.literal: Powerful feared, beheaded rebels to present, Yi people from this all wary subdued.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftains were afraid, beheaded the rebels and presented their heads, and from then on the tribal peoples all lived in wary submission.

sentences.zh: 三十年，知饒州，尋除敷文閣待制。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, know Raozhou, soon removed Fuwen Pavilion attendant draft.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was appointed Prefect of Raozhou, and soon thereafter was made Attendant Draftsman at the Fuwen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 乾道初，守婺州，召還，提舉佑神觀兼侍講。

translations.literal: Qiandao beginning, guard Wuzhou, summoned return, propose raise You Shen Temple concurrently lecturer-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qiandao era he governed Wuzhou, was recalled to court, and was appointed Director of the You Shen Temple, concurrently serving as Lecturer-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 首進二說，以為王道在正心誠意，立國在節用愛人。

translations.literal: First presented two doctrines, thinking royal way in rectifying heart sincere intent, founding state in economizing love people.
translations.idiomatic: He first submitted two theses, arguing that the royal way lay in rectifying the heart and making intention sincere, and that founding a state lay in economizing expenditure and cherishing the people.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，復為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Second year fourth month, again became Ministry of Rites vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year he was again made Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 孝宗患人才難知，執羔曰：「今一介干進，亦蒙賜召，口舌相高，殆成風俗，豈可使之得志哉！」

translations.literal: Xiaozong troubled talent hard know, Zhigao said: "Now one petty office-seeker, also receives granted summons, mouth tongue mutually exalt, nearly becoming custom, how can allow them achieve ambition!"
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong worried that it was hard to discern talent. Zhigao said: "Nowadays even the lowliest office-seeker may be summoned to court. Rivalry in glib talk has nearly become a custom—how can such people be allowed to succeed?"

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿言是也。」

translations.literal: Emperor said: "Your words are correct."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "What you say is right."

sentences.zh: 一日侍經筵，自言「學《易》知數，臣事陛下之日短」，已乃垂涕，上惻然。

translations.literal: One day attended classics mat, himself said "studied Changes know fate, minister served Your Majesty days short," then shed tears, emperor moved.
translations.idiomatic: One day, while attending the classics lecture, he said of himself, "Having studied the Changes, I know my allotted span; the days in which I may serve Your Majesty are few." He then burst into tears, and the emperor was deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 即拜本部尚書，升侍讀，固辭，不許。

translations.literal: Immediately appointed this ministry minister, promoted lecturer-in-waiting, firmly declined, not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately appointed Minister of his department and promoted to Lecturer-in-Waiting. He firmly declined, but the emperor would not allow it.

sentences.zh: 方士劉孝榮言《統元曆》差，命執羔厘正之。

translations.literal: Fangshi Liu Xiaorong said Tongyuan Calendar error, ordered Zhigao rectify it.
translations.idiomatic: The adept Liu Xiaorong reported errors in the Tongyuan Calendar, and Zhigao was ordered to correct it.

sentences.zh: 執羔用劉義叟法，推日月交食，考五緯贏縮，以紀氣朔寒溫之候，撰《曆議》、《曆書》、《五星測驗》各一卷上之。

translations.literal: Zhigao used Liu Yishou method, calculate sun moon eclipses, examine five planets excess deficit, to record qi new moon cold warm signs, composed Calendar Discourse, Calendar Book, Five Stars Verification each one scroll submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhigao applied the methods of Liu Yishou, calculated solar and lunar eclipses, and examined the advance and retreat of the five planets to record the signs of seasonal qi, new moons, and cold and warmth. He compiled one scroll each of A Discourse on the Calendar, A Book on the Calendar, and Verification of the Five Planets, and submitted them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上嘗問豐財之術，執羔以為蠹民之本，莫甚於兵。

translations.literal: Emperor once asked enrich treasury method, Zhigao thought harm people root, none exceeding soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once asked about methods to enrich the treasury. Zhigao held that nothing harmed the people more deeply as a root cause than the military.

sentences.zh: 古者興師十萬，日費千金。

translations.literal: Ancient ones raise army hundred thousand, daily expense thousand gold.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, raising an army of a hundred thousand cost a thousand gold pieces a day.

sentences.zh: 今尺籍之數，十倍於此，罷癃老弱者幾半，不汰之其弊益深。

translations.literal: Now roster numbers, ten times this, disabled enfeebled old weak nearly half, not eliminate them harm deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Today's roster figures are ten times that, and nearly half the men are crippled, enfeebled, old, or weak. If they are not weeded out, the harm will only deepen.

sentences.zh: 論：「和糴本以給軍興，豫凶災。

translations.literal: Discussed: "Harmonious purchase originally to supply military rise, prepare fierce disaster.
translations.idiomatic: He argued: "Government grain purchase was originally meant to supply military needs and prepare for famine and disaster.

sentences.zh: 蓋國家一切之政，不得已而為之。

translations.literal: Probably state all policies, no choice but therefore do them.
translations.idiomatic: All such policies of the state are measures taken only when there is no alternative.

sentences.zh: 若邊境無事，妨於民食而務為聚斂，可乎？

translations.literal: If border no incident, obstruct people food yet strive for accumulation, can it?
translations.idiomatic: If the borders are peaceful, is it acceptable to impede the people's food supply and yet strive to accumulate revenue?

sentences.zh: 舊糴有常數，比年每郡增至一二十萬石。

translations.literal: Old purchase had fixed quota, recent years each prefecture increased to one-two hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Grain purchases formerly had fixed quotas, but in recent years each prefecture has increased them to one or two hundred thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 今諸路枯旱之餘，蟲螟大起，無以供常稅，況數外取之乎？

translations.literal: Now all circuits drought aftermath, locusts greatly arise, none to supply regular tax, moreover beyond quota take from them?
translations.idiomatic: Now, after drought across the circuits, locust plagues have broken out on a great scale. The people cannot even meet ordinary tax levies—how much less tolerate collections beyond the quotas?

sentences.zh: 宜視一路一郡一縣豐凶之數，輕重行之，災甚者蠲之可也。」

translations.literal: Should regard one circuit one prefecture one county abundance scarcity numbers, light heavy implement, disaster severe exempt can also."
translations.idiomatic: Purchases should be adjusted in severity according to whether a circuit, prefecture, or county has had bounty or famine, and where disaster is severe they may be remitted altogether.

sentences.zh: 上矍然曰：「災異如此，乃無一人為朕言者！」

translations.literal: Emperor startled said: "Disaster anomaly like this, yet not one person for Us speak!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said in alarm: "Disasters and portents are so grave, yet not one person has spoken of this to me!"

sentences.zh: 即詔從之。

translations.literal: Immediately edict followed it.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately issued an edict adopting the proposal.

sentences.zh: 充安恭皇后菆宮按行使，日與閹人接，卒事未嘗交一談，閹亦服其長者，不怨也。

translations.literal: Filled Empress An Gong provisional tomb inspection envoy, daily with eunuchs contact, finished affairs never once exchanged one talk, eunuchs also admired his elder manner, not resent.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as inspection envoy at the provisional tomb of Empress An Gong, he was in daily contact with eunuchs yet never exchanged a single private word with them from start to finish. Even the eunuchs respected him as a man of maturity and bore no resentment.

sentences.zh: 拜疏求去，上謂輔臣曰：「朕惜其老成，宜以經筵留之。」

translations.literal: Submitted memorial request leave, emperor told assisting ministers said: "We cherish his mature steadiness, should with classics mat retain him."
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial requesting leave, and the emperor told his chief ministers: "I value his mature judgment and ought to keep him at the classics lecture."

sentences.zh: 除寶文閣學士，提舉佑神觀。

translations.literal: Removed Baowen Pavilion scholar, propose raise You Shen Temple.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Scholar of the Baowen Pavilion and Director of the You Shen Temple.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「遂除龍圖可也。」

translations.literal: Emperor said: "Then remove Dragon Diagram can also."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "He may be made a Dragon Diagram Scholar as well."

sentences.zh: 經筵二年，每勸上以辨忠邪、納諫爭，上深知其忠。

translations.literal: Classics mat two years, each exhorted emperor on distinguish loyal wicked, accept remonstrance contention, emperor deeply knew his loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: For two years at the classics lecture he repeatedly urged the emperor to distinguish loyalty from treachery and to accept remonstrance and debate. The emperor came to know his loyalty well.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，告老，上諭曰：「祖宗時，近臣有年逾八十尚留者，卿之齒未也。」

translations.literal: Next year third month, announced old age, emperor instructed said: "Ancestors time, close ministers had years exceed eighty still retained, your age not yet."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the following year he petitioned to retire on grounds of age. The emperor instructed him: "In the time of our ancestors, close ministers sometimes remained in office even past eighty. You are not yet so old."

sentences.zh: 命卻其章。

translations.literal: Ordered reject his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered his petition returned.

sentences.zh: 閏月，復申前請。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, again stated previous request.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month he repeated his earlier request.

sentences.zh: 上度不可奪，詔提舉江州太平興國宮，賜茶、藥、御書，恩禮尤渥，公卿祖帳都門外，搢紳榮之。

translations.literal: Emperor judged not can deny, edict propose raise Jiangzhou Taiping Xingguo Palace, granted tea medicine imperial writing, grace rites especially generous, dukes ministers farewell feast capital gate outside, gentry officials honored it.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that his resolve could not be changed, the emperor ordered him appointed Director of the Taiping Xingguo Palace in Jiangzhou, granted tea, medicine, and imperial calligraphy. The honors were especially generous, and high officials gave him a farewell feast outside the capital gate—to the admiration of the gentry.

sentences.zh: 時閩、粵、江西歲饑盜起，執羔陛辭以為言，詔遣太府丞馬希言使諸路振救之。

translations.literal: Then Fujian Guangdong Jiangxi year famine bandits rise, Zhigao court farewell spoke of it, edict dispatched Taifu cheng Ma Xiyan envoy all circuits relief rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time famine had struck Fujian, Guangdong, and Jiangxi, and bandits were rising. Zhigao raised the matter in his farewell audience, and an edict was issued dispatching the Palace Storehouse Assistant Ma Xiyan to the various circuits to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年卒，年七十七。

translations.literal: Qiandao sixth year died, age seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year of the Qiandao era, at the age of seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 執羔有雅度，立朝無朋比。

translations.literal: Zhigao had refined bearing, stood court no faction clinging.
translations.idiomatic: Zhigao had a dignified bearing and formed no factions at court.

sentences.zh: 治郡廉恕，有循吏風。

translations.literal: Governed prefectures honest forgiving, had upright official wind.
translations.idiomatic: In governing prefectures he was honest and lenient, with the manner of an exemplary local official.

sentences.zh: 手不釋卷，尤通于《易》。

translations.literal: Hand not release scroll, especially proficient in Changes.
translations.idiomatic: He never put his books aside and was especially versed in the Book of Changes.

sentences.zh: 王希呂

translations.literal: Wang Xilu
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xilu

sentences.zh: 王希呂，字仲行，宿州人。

translations.literal: Wang Xilu, courtesy name Zhongxing, Suzhou person.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xilu, courtesy name Zhongxing, was a native of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 渡江後自北歸南，既仕，寓居嘉興府。

translations.literal: Crossed river after from north returned south, already served office, resided Jiaxing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After crossing the Yangtze he came south from the north. Once in office, he made his home in Jiaxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乾道五年，登進士科。

translations.literal: Qiandao fifth year, ascended jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Qiandao reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 孝宗獎用西北之士，六年，召試，授秘書省正字。

translations.literal: Xiaozong rewarded used northwest scholars, sixth year, summoned trial, granted Secretariat collator.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong encouraged the appointment of men from the northwest. In the sixth year Wang was summoned for an examination and granted the post of Collator in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 除右正言。

translations.literal: Removed Right Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Remonstrator of the Right.

sentences.zh: 時張說以攀援戚屬擢用，再除簽書樞密院事，希呂與侍御史李衡交章劾之。

translations.literal: Then Zhang Shuo because clinging relatives elevated used, again removed co-sign Secretariat Military Affairs, Xilu with attendant censor Li Heng submitted memorials impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Shuo had been promoted through connections to imperial kin and was again appointed Co-signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Xilu and the Attendant Censor Li Heng submitted successive memorials impeaching him.

sentences.zh: 上疑其合黨邀名，責遠小監當，既而悔之，改授宮觀。

translations.literal: Emperor suspected them faction seek fame, rebuked remote petty supervisory assignment, soon after regretted, changed grant palace-temple post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected them of forming a faction to win renown and punished them with petty remote supervisory posts. He soon regretted this and changed their appointments to palace-temple sinecures.

sentences.zh: 方說之見用，氣勢顯赫，後省不書黃，學士院不草詔，皆相繼斥逐，而希呂復以身任怨，去國之日，屏徒御，躡履以行，恬不為悔。

translations.literal: When Shuo being used, authority conspicuous, rear secretariat not write yellow, Hanlin Academy not draft edicts, all successively expelled, yet Xilu again with body bore blame, leave state day, dismissed attendants carriage, tiptoed shoes to walk, calmly not regret.
translations.idiomatic: While Zhang Shuo was in favor his power was dazzling. Those in the rear secretariat who refused to write the approval notices and those in the Hanlin Academy who refused to draft edicts were all successively driven out. Yet Xilu again took the blame upon himself; on the day he left the capital he dismissed his attendants and carriage and walked away in his shoes, untroubled and unrepentant.

sentences.zh: 由是直聲聞於遠邇，雖以此黜，亦以此見知。

translations.literal: From this upright reputation heard near far, although because this dismissed, also because this seen known.
translations.idiomatic: From this his reputation for integrity was heard far and near; though he was dismissed for it, he was also recognized because of it.

sentences.zh: 出知廬州。

translations.literal: Out know Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out to serve as Prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年，除吏部員外郎，尋除起居郎兼中書舍人。

translations.literal: Chunxi second year, removed Ministry of Personnel external vice director, soon removed Attendant on Emperor concurrently Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Chunxi reign he was appointed External Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, and soon thereafter Attendant on the Emperor, concurrently serving as Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 淮右擇帥，上以希呂已試有功，令知廬州兼安撫使。

translations.literal: Huai west select commander, emperor because Xilu already tested had merit, ordered know Luzhou concurrently pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When choosing a commander for the region west of the Huai, the emperor, seeing that Xilu had already proved himself effective, ordered him to govern Luzhou while concurrently serving as Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 修葺城守，安集流散，兵民賴之。

translations.literal: Repair city defenses, settle gather scattered refugees, soldiers people relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired the city defenses, settled scattered refugees, and both soldiers and civilians relied on him.

sentences.zh: 加直寶文閣、江西轉運副使。

translations.literal: Added straight Baowen Pavilion, Jiangxi transport vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was additionally granted direct access to the Baowen Pavilion and appointed Vice Transport Commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 五年，召為起居郎，除中書舍人、給事中，轉兵部尚書，改吏部尚書，求去，乃除端明殿學士、知紹興府。

translations.literal: Fifth year, summoned as Attendant on Emperor, removed Secretariat drafter presenting memorials, transferred Ministry War minister, changed Ministry Personnel minister, requested leave, then removed Duannming Hall scholar know Shaoxing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was recalled as Attendant on the Emperor, appointed Secretariat Drafter and Receiving Edicts, then promoted to Minister of War and transferred to Minister of Personnel. When he requested leave, he was made Scholar of the Duannming Hall and Prefect of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 尋以言者落職，處之晏如。

translations.literal: Soon because critics dismissed office, treated it easy as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward critics had him stripped of office, yet he took it as calmly as ever.

sentences.zh: 治郡百廢俱興，尤敬禮文學端方之士。

translations.literal: Governed prefecture hundred neglected all revived, especially honored literary upright scholars.
translations.idiomatic: In governing the prefecture he revived every neglected undertaking and especially honored scholars of learning and integrity.

sentences.zh: 天性剛勁，遇利害無回護意，惟是之從。

translations.literal: Nature by birth firm strong, encountering benefit harm no protect-shield intent, only right followed.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was firm and unyielding. Where gain or harm was at stake he showed no partiality and followed only what was right.

sentences.zh: 嘗論近習用事，語極切至，上變色欲起，希呂挽御衣曰：「非但臣能言之，侍從、臺諫皆有文字來矣。」

translations.literal: Once discussed close attendants wield power, words extremely cutting, emperor changed color wanted rise, Xilu pulled imperial robe said: "Not only minister can speak it, attendants remonstrators all have writings come already."
translations.idiomatic: Once, when he spoke about close favorites wielding power, his words were extraordinarily pointed. The emperor changed color and started to rise, but Xilu held his imperial robe and said: "Your servant is not the only one who can say this—the attendants and remonstrating officials have all submitted writings on the matter."

sentences.zh: 佐漕江西，嘗作《拳石記》以示僚屬，一幕官舉筆塗數字，舉坐駭愕，希呂覽之，喜其不阿，薦之。

translations.literal: Assisted transport Jiangxi, once composed Fist Stone Record to show subordinates, one staff official raised brush altered several characters, whole assembly shocked, Xilu viewed it, pleased at his not fawning, recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: While assisting grain transport in Jiangxi, he once wrote Record of the Fist-Sized Stone to show his staff. One clerical officer picked up a brush and altered several characters—to the shock of all present. Xilu read it and, pleased that the man did not fawn, recommended him.

sentences.zh: 居官廉潔，至無屋可廬，由紹興歸，有終焉之意，然猶寓僧寺。

translations.literal: Held office honest clean, to point no house could lodge, from Shaoxing returned, had end-here intent, yet still lodged Buddhist temple.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was honest and incorruptible—so much so that he had no house in which to live. When he returned from Shaoxing he intended to settle there for good, yet still lodged in a Buddhist temple.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，賜錢造第。

translations.literal: Emperor heard it, granted money build residence.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of this, he granted him money to build a house.

sentences.zh: 後以疾卒於家。

translations.literal: Later because illness died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He later died of illness at home.

sentences.zh: 陳良祐

translations.literal: Chen Liangyou
translations.idiomatic: Chen Liangyou

sentences.zh: 首言會子之弊，願捐內帑以紓細民之急。

translations.literal: First spoke hui-zi flaws, wished donate inner treasury to relieve common people urgency.
translations.idiomatic: He first spoke of the abuses of paper notes and wished to draw on the inner treasury to relieve the distress of the common people.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕積財何用，能散可也。」

translations.literal: Emperor said: "We accumulate wealth what use, can disperse can also."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "What use is it for me to hoard wealth? It is enough that I can give it away."

sentences.zh: 慨然發內府白金數萬兩收換會子，收銅版勿造，軍民翕然。

translations.literal: Moved issued inner palace white silver several ten thousand taels to redeem exchange hui-zi, collected copper plates not manufacture, soldiers people united pleased.
translations.idiomatic: He forthwith issued several tens of thousands of taels of silver from the inner palace to buy back the notes, collected the copper printing plates and ordered no more made, and soldiers and civilians alike were heartened.

sentences.zh: 未幾，戶部得請，改造五百萬。

translations.literal: Not long, Ministry Revenue obtained permission, reissue five million.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Ministry of Revenue obtained approval to reissue five million notes.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「陛下號令在前，不能持半歲久，以此令民，誰能信之？

translations.literal: Again memorialized: "Your Majesty command before, not can hold half year long, with this command people, who can believe it?
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again: "Your Majesty's command was issued earlier, yet it could not hold even half a year. With such commands given to the people, who can believe them?

sentences.zh: 豈有不印交子五百萬，遂不可為國乎？」

translations.literal: How can not print exchange notes five million, then not can be state?"
translations.idiomatic: Surely the state does not become impossible for lack of printing five million jiaozi?"

sentences.zh: 既而又欲造會子二千萬，屢爭之不得，遂請以五百萬換舊會，俟通行漸收之，常使不越千萬之數。

translations.literal: Already again wanted create hui-zi twenty million, repeatedly contended not obtain, then requested use five million exchange old notes, wait circulation gradually collect them, always keep not exceed ten million number.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when there was again a plan to issue twenty million new notes, he repeatedly objected but could not prevail. He then requested that five million be issued to replace the old notes, that as they circulated they be gradually withdrawn, and that the total be kept from exceeding ten million.

sentences.zh: 上銳意圖治，以唐太宗自比，良祐言：「太宗《政要》願賜省覽，擇善而從，知非而戒，使臣為良臣，勿為忠臣。」

translations.literal: Emperor keen intent plan govern, with Tang Taizong self compare, Liangyou said: "Taizong Essentials of Governance wish granted examine, select good follow, know wrong and warn, make ministers good ministers, not loyal ministers."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was keen to govern well and compared himself to Emperor Taizong of Tang. Liangyou said: "I beg that Your Majesty read Taizong's Essentials of Governance, follow what is good, take warning from what was wrong, and make your ministers good ministers rather than loyal ministers."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿亦當以魏徵自勉。」

translations.literal: Emperor said: "You also should with Wei Zheng self encourage."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "You too should take Wei Zheng as your model."

sentences.zh: 又言：「陛下躬行節儉，弗殖貨利。

translations.literal: Again said: "Your Majesty personally practice economy, not accumulate goods profit.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Your Majesty personally practices thrift and does not amass profit for yourself.

sentences.zh: 或者託肺腑之親，為市井之行，以公侯之貴，牟商賈之利。

translations.literal: Some rely on bosom kin, do market street conduct, with duke marquis nobility, seek merchant profit.
translations.idiomatic: Yet some, relying on their closeness to Your Majesty, behave like market folk and, despite the rank of duke or marquis, pursue merchants' profits.

sentences.zh: 占田疇，擅山澤，甚者發舶舟，招蕃賈，貿易寶貨，麋費金錢。

translations.literal: Seize fields, monopolize mountains marshes, severe ones dispatch ships, invite foreign merchants, trade precious goods, waste spend gold money.
translations.idiomatic: They seize fields, monopolize mountains and marshes, and in the worst cases dispatch ships, invite foreign merchants, trade in precious goods, and squander gold and silver.

sentences.zh: 或假德壽，或託椒房，犯法冒禁，專利無厭，非所以維持紀綱，保全戚畹。

translations.literal: Some borrow Deshou, some rely on consort quarters, violate laws dare prohibitions, monopolize profit without satiety, not the means maintain discipline, preserve imperial kin.
translations.idiomatic: Some invoke ties to the retired emperor at Deshou Palace, others rely on connections to the imperial consorts; they violate laws, defy prohibitions, and pursue profit without limit. This is no way to uphold discipline or protect the imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 願嚴戒敕，苟能改過，富貴可保，如其不悛，以義斷恩。」

translations.literal: Wish strict warnings edicts, if can reform faults, wealth nobility can preserve, if they not repent, by righteousness sever grace."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Your Majesty issue strict warnings: if they can reform, their wealth and rank may be preserved; if they will not repent, sever ties to them in the name of righteousness."

sentences.zh: 時左相丁外艱，詔起復，良祐言：「起復非正禮，今無疆場之事，宜使之終喪。」

translations.literal: Then Left Chancellor completed external mourning, edict recalled to service, Liangyou said: "Recall from mourning not proper ritual, now no frontier affairs, should make him complete mourning."
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Left Chancellor was in mourning for his father, an edict ordered him recalled to office. Liangyou said: "Recall from mourning is not proper ritual. There are no frontier emergencies now; he should be allowed to complete his mourning."

sentences.zh: 遂寢。

translations.literal: Then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was then dropped.

sentences.zh: 遷右諫議大夫兼侍講，同知貢舉，除給事中，兼直學士院，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Transferred Right Remonstrance and Discussion Grand Master concurrently Lecturer, co-supervise examinations, removed Receiving Edicts, concurrently direct Hanlin Academy, transferred Ministry of Personnel vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Remonstrance and Discussion Grand Master and concurrently made Lecturer, co-supervisor of the imperial examinations, appointed Receiving Edicts and concurrently given direct access to the Hanlin Academy, and then promoted to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 尋除尚書。

translations.literal: Soon removed Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed Minister.

sentences.zh: 時議遣泛使請地，良祐奏：

translations.literal: Then discussed send general envoy request territory, Liangyou memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was discussion of sending a general envoy to request territory. Liangyou memorialized:

sentences.zh: 「陛下恢復之志未嘗忘懷，然詞莫貴於僉同，不可不察；

translations.literal: "Your Majesty recovery intent never forgotten heart, yet words none more valued than unanimous assent, cannot not examine;
translations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty's resolve to recover lost territory has never left your heart, yet in policy nothing is more prized than unanimous agreement, and this cannot go unexamined;

sentences.zh: 博訪歸於獨斷，不可不審。

translations.literal: Broad inquiry returns to sole decision, cannot not scrutinize.
translations.idiomatic: nor can broad consultation that ends in a sole decision go unscrutinized.

sentences.zh: 固有以用眾而興，亦有以用眾而亡；

translations.literal: Indeed have by using multitude risen, also have by using multitude perished;
translations.idiomatic: There have indeed been states that rose by following the multitude, and also states that perished by following the multitude;

sentences.zh: 固有以獨斷而成，亦有以獨斷而敗。

translations.literal: Indeed have by sole decision succeeded, also have by sole decision failed.
translations.idiomatic: there have been those who succeeded by acting alone, and also those who failed by acting alone.

sentences.zh: 今遣使乃啟釁之端，萬一敵騎犯邊，則民力困於供輸，州郡疲於調發，兵禍結，未有息期。

translations.literal: Now send envoy then opens provocation beginning, in case enemy cavalry violate border, then people strength trapped in supply transport, prefectures counties exhausted in mobilization, military disaster knotted, not yet cease period.
translations.idiomatic: Sending an envoy now would open the door to provocation. If enemy cavalry should violate the border, the people's strength would be drained by supply levies, prefectures and counties would be worn out by mobilization, and military disaster would ensue with no end in sight.

sentences.zh: 將帥庸鄙，類乏遠謀，對君父則言效死，臨戰陣則各求生。

translations.literal: Generals vulgar base, mostly lack far planning, facing lord father then speak devote death, facing battle array then each seek life.
translations.idiomatic: Our generals are mediocre and crude, mostly lacking far-sighted plans; before the sovereign they speak of dying in his service, yet on the battlefield each seeks to save himself.

sentences.zh: 有如符離之役，不戰自潰，瓜洲之遇，望敵驚奔，孰可仗者？

translations.literal: Like Fuli campaign, not fight self routed, Guazhou encounter, seeing enemy startled flee, who can rely on?
translations.idiomatic: Witness the battle at Fuli, where the army routed itself without fighting, and the encounter at Guazhou, where men fled in panic at the sight of the enemy—on whom can we rely?

sentences.zh: 此臣所以未敢保其萬全。

translations.literal: This minister therefore not dare guarantee its ten thousand completeness.
translations.idiomatic: This is why your servant dares not guarantee complete success.

sentences.zh: 且今之求地，欲得河南，曩歲嘗歸版圖，不旋踵而又失，如其不許，徒費往來，若其許我，必邀重幣。

translations.literal: Moreover now request territory, wish obtain Henan, former years once returned to map, not turn heel again lost, if they not grant, vainly waste going returning, if they grant us, must demand heavy gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the territory sought now is Henan. In former years it was once returned to our map, yet before we could turn around we lost it again. If they refuse, the mission will have been wasted; if they grant our request, they will surely demand heavy tribute.

sentences.zh: 經理未定，根本內虛，又將隨而取之矣。

translations.literal: Management not settled, root foundation inner empty, again will follow and take it.
translations.idiomatic: With our internal administration unsettled and our foundations hollow within, they will simply take it back again.

sentences.zh: 向之四郡得之亦勤，尚不能有，今又無故而求侵地，陛下度可以虛聲下之乎？

translations.literal: Former four prefectures obtained also with toil, still not could hold, now again without reason seek encroaching territory, Your Majesty estimate can by empty voice subdue them?
translations.idiomatic: The four prefectures we gained before were won only with great effort, and even then we could not hold them. Now, without cause, we seek further territory—does Your Majesty think they can be brought to yield by empty words?

sentences.zh: 況止求陵寢，地在其中，曩亦議此，觀其答書，幾於相戲。

translations.literal: Moreover only seek imperial tombs, territory within them, formerly also discussed this, view their reply letter, nearly like mutual mockery.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, if we seek only the imperial tombs, the land lies within their territory. This too was discussed before, and judging from their reply, it was nearly a mockery.

sentences.zh: 凡此二端，皆是求釁。

translations.literal: All these two ends, all are seeking provocation.
translations.idiomatic: Both of these courses alike amount to seeking provocation.

sentences.zh: 必須遣使，則祈請欽宗梓宮，猶為有辭。

translations.literal: Must send envoy, then pray request Qinzong coffin palace, still has reason.
translations.idiomatic: If an envoy must be sent, then to petition for the return of Emperor Qinzong's coffin would at least offer grounds.

sentences.zh: 內視不足，何暇事外？

translations.literal: Inward view not sufficient, what leisure affairs external?
translations.idiomatic: When our internal affairs are not in order, how can we spare attention for external matters?

sentences.zh: 邇者未懷，豈能綏遠？」

translations.literal: Near ones not embraced, how can pacify far?"
translations.idiomatic: When those near at hand are not yet won over, how can we bring peace to those far away?"

sentences.zh: 奏入，忤旨，貶瑞州居住，尋移信州。

translations.literal: Memorial entered, offended intent, demoted Ruizhou reside, soon moved Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, it offended the emperor's intent. He was demoted and ordered to reside in Ruizhou, and soon afterward was transferred to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，許令自便。

translations.literal: Ninth year, permitted order self convenience.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was permitted to go where he pleased.

sentences.zh: 淳熙四年，起知徽州，尋除敷文閣待制、知建寧府，卒。

translations.literal: Chunxi fourth year, raised know Huizhou, soon removed Fuwenge attendant, know Jianning prefecture, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Chunxi reign he was recalled to serve as Prefect of Huizhou, and soon afterward was made Attendant of the Fuwenge Pavilion and Prefect of Jianning Prefecture. He died in office.

sentences.zh: 李浩，字德遠，其先居建昌，遷臨川。

translations.literal: Li Hao, courtesy name Deyuan, his ancestors resided Jianchang, moved Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hao, courtesy name Deyuan, was descended from a family that had lived in Jianchang and later moved to Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 浩早有文稱。

translations.literal: Hao early had literary reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Hao early gained a reputation for literary talent.

sentences.zh: 紹興十二年，擢進士第。

translations.literal: Shaoxing twelfth year, selected jinshi rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Shaoxing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 時秦熺挾宰相子以魁多士，同年皆見之，或拉浩行，毅然不往。

translations.literal: Then Qin Xi relied on chancellor's son to head many scholars, same year all visited him, some pulled Hao go, resolutely not went.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Qin Xi, as the chancellor's son, ranked first among the successful candidates. His classmates all called on him, and some tried to pull Hao along, but he steadfastly refused to go.

sentences.zh: 調饒州司戶參軍、襄陽府觀察推官，連丁內外艱，繼調金州教授，改太常寺主簿，尋兼光祿寺丞。

translations.literal: Transferred Raozhou Revenue Section aide, Xiangyang prefecture observation investigating officer, successively completed inner outer mourning, then transferred Jinzhou instructor, changed Court of Imperial Sacrifices registrar, soon concurrently Court of Imperial Entertainments assistant director.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Revenue Section Aide of Raozhou and Investigating Officer of Xiangyang Prefecture, successively completed mourning for both parents, then was transferred to Instructor at Jinzhou, promoted to Registrar of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and soon thereafter concurrently made Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 輪對，首陳《無逸》之戒，且言：「宿衛大將楊存中恩寵特異，待之過，非其福。」

translations.literal: Rotation audience, first presented No Dissipation warning, and said: "Palace guard great general Yang Cunzhong grace favor exceptionally special, treating him excessively, not his blessing."
translations.idiomatic: At a rotating audience he first cited the warning in No Dissipation and said: "The great general of the palace guard, Yang Cunzhong, enjoys exceptional favor. To treat him so lavishly is no blessing to him."

sentences.zh: 上悟，旋令就第。

translations.literal: Emperor understood, soon ordered return to residence.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took his meaning and soon ordered Yang to retire to his residence.

sentences.zh: 自秦檜用事，塞言路，及上總攬權綱，激厲忠讜，此習尚存，朝士多務慎默。

translations.literal: From Qin Hui wielded power, blocked speech routes, until emperor gathered authority reins, encouraged loyal remonstrance, this habit still remained, court officials mostly pursued cautious silence.
translations.idiomatic: Since Qin Hui had wielded power and blocked the channels of remonstrance, and even after the emperor gathered authority to himself and sought to encourage loyal speech, the old habit remained and court officials mostly kept silent out of caution.

sentences.zh: 至是命百官轉對，浩與王十朋、馮方、查籥、胡憲始相繼言事，聞者興起。

translations.literal: To this ordered hundred officials rotate audience, Hao with Wang Shipeng, Feng Fang, Zha Yao, Hu Xian first successively spoke affairs, hearers stirred.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the emperor ordered officials to speak in rotation. Hao, together with Wang Shipeng, Feng Fang, Zha Yao, and Hu Xian, were the first to speak in succession on affairs of state, and those who heard them were stirred.

sentences.zh: 浩不安於朝，請祠，主管台州崇道觀以歸。

translations.literal: Hao not at ease at court, requested temple post, supervised Taizhou Chongdao Abbey then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Hao was ill at ease at court, requested a temple appointment, and returned home as supervisor of the Chongdao Abbey in Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，以太常丞召。

translations.literal: Xiaozong ascended throne, with Taichang cheng summoned.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong ascended the throne, Hao was summoned as Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 時張浚督師江、淮，宰相多抑之，浩引仁宗用韓琦、范仲淹詔章得象故事，乞戒諭令同心協濟。

translations.literal: Then Zhang Jun supervised army Jiang Huai, chancellors mostly restrained him, Hao cited Renzong used Han Qi Fan Zhongyan edict Zhang Dexiang precedent, begged admonish instruct make same heart cooperate assist.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Jun was directing troops on the Jiang and Huai fronts, and the chancellors mostly held him back. Hao cited the precedent of Emperor Renzong's edict employing Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan and asked that the emperor admonish the court to unite in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 兼權吏部郎官。

translations.literal: Concurrently acting Ministry of Personnel bureau official.
translations.idiomatic: He was concurrently appointed Acting Bureau Official of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 浩雅為湯思退所厚，御史尹穡欲引之以共擠浚，因薦浩。

translations.literal: Hao by nature by Tang Situi thickly favored, censor Yin Ji wished draw him to together squeeze Jun, therefore recommended Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Hao had long been favored by Tang Situi. The censor Yin Ji wished to draw him in to help squeeze out Zhang Jun and therefore recommended Hao.

sentences.zh: 及對，乃明示不同之意，二人皆不樂。

translations.literal: When audience, then clearly showed different intent, two men both displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When he had his audience, he clearly showed a different intent, and both men were displeased.

sentences.zh: 踰年，始除員外郎兼皇子恭王府直講。

translations.literal: Over year, first removed external bureau official concurrently Prince Gongwang mansion direct lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year passed before he was appointed External Bureau Official and Direct Lecturer in the mansion of the Prince of Gong.

sentences.zh: 在王府多所裨益，且因事以及時政，書之於冊，幸上或見之，王亦素所愛重。

translations.literal: In princely mansion much benefit, moreover by affairs extend to current politics, wrote them in book, hoped emperor perhaps see them, prince also by nature loved valued him.
translations.idiomatic: In the princely mansion he was of much benefit, and he also used occasions to touch on current politics and wrote them in a book, hoping the emperor might see it. The prince too had long loved and valued him.

sentences.zh: 他日外補，累年以歸，王喜曰：「李直講來矣。」

translations.literal: Another day external appointment, accumulated years then returned, prince pleased said: "Li Direct Lecturer has come."
translations.idiomatic: When he later took an outside appointment and returned after several years, the prince said with pleasure: "Direct Lecturer Li has come."

sentences.zh: 未幾，宰相召為郎者四人，將進用之，尤屬意浩。

translations.literal: Not long, chancellor summoned as bureau officials four men, about to promote use them, especially set intent on Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the chancellor summoned four men to serve as bureau officials and intended to promote them, setting his hopes especially on Hao.

sentences.zh: 浩嘿然無一辭，同舍皆遷，浩獨如故。

translations.literal: Hao silent not one word, same lodging all transferred, Hao alone as before.
translations.idiomatic: Hao remained silent and said not a word. His colleagues were all promoted, but Hao alone remained as before.

sentences.zh: 逾年，浙河水災，詔郎官、館職以上條時政闕失，浩謂上憂勞如此，今何可不言，即奏疏指論近臣，並及宰執惟奉行，臺諫多迎合，百執事顧忌畏縮。

translations.literal: Over year, Zhe river water disaster, edict bureau officials academy posts and above itemize current politics omissions failures, Hao said emperor worry labor thus, now how can not speak, immediately memorial pointed discussed close ministers, together reached chancellors only carry out, remonstrators mostly flatter comply, hundred officials look back fear shrink.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Zhe River flooded. An edict ordered bureau officials and academy appointees and above to itemize omissions in current policy. Hao said that with the emperor so burdened with worry, how could he remain silent? He immediately submitted a memorial criticizing close ministers and extending his criticism to the chancellors, who merely carried out orders; remonstrators who mostly flattered and complied; and officials who looked back in fear and shrank from action.

sentences.zh: 反覆數千言，傾倒罄竭，見者悚慄。

translations.literal: Repeated several thousand words, poured out exhausted, viewers shuddered.
translations.idiomatic: Running to several thousand words, he poured out everything he had to say, and those who read it were shaken.

sentences.zh: 上不以為忤，執事者深忌之。

translations.literal: Emperor not considered offense, executors deeply resented him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not take it as an offense, but those in power deeply resented him.

sentences.zh: 乞外，得台州。

translations.literal: Begged outside appointment, obtained Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He requested an outside appointment and was given Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 州有揀中禁軍五百人，訓練官貪殘失眾心，不逞者因謀作亂，忽露刃於庭，浩謂之曰：「汝等欲為亂乎？

translations.literal: Prefecture had selected central army five hundred men, training officer greedy cruel lost people's hearts, unruly ones therefore plotted make disorder, suddenly bared blades in court, Hao said to them: "You all wish make disorder?
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had five hundred selected troops of the central army. The training officer was greedy and cruel and had lost the men's loyalty. The unruly among them plotted mutiny and suddenly bared their blades in the courtyard. Hao said to them: "Do you wish to rebel?

sentences.zh: 請先殺我。」

translations.literal: Please first kill me."
translations.idiomatic: Then kill me first."

sentences.zh: 眾駭曰：「不敢。」

translations.literal: Crowd startled said: "Not dare."
translations.idiomatic: The men were startled and said: "We dare not."

sentences.zh: 乃徐推其為首者四人黥徙之，迄無事。

translations.literal: Then slowly pushed out their ringleaders four men tattooed exiled them, to end no incident.
translations.idiomatic: He then calmly identified the four ringleaders, had them tattooed and exiled, and thereafter there was no further trouble.

sentences.zh: 除直秘閣。

translations.literal: Removed direct Secret Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted direct access to the Secret Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 並海有宿寇，久不獲，浩募其徒，自縛贖罪，即得其魁。

translations.literal: Along coast had long-standing bandits, long not captured, Hao recruited their followers, self bound redeem guilt, immediately obtained their chief.
translations.idiomatic: Along the coast there were long-standing bandits who had long evaded capture. Hao recruited their followers, offering them redemption if they bound themselves and surrendered, and immediately obtained the ringleader.

sentences.zh: 里豪民鄭憲以貲給事權貴人門，囊橐為姦，事覺，械繫之，死獄中，盡籍其家，徙其妻孥。

translations.literal: A district magnate, Zheng Xian, used his wealth to serve at the gates of the powerful and filled his purse with wrongdoing; when the affair was exposed, Hao had him shackled and imprisoned; he died in jail, his household was fully confiscated, and his wife and children were banished.
translations.idiomatic: A local magnate, Zheng Xian, used his wealth to serve powerful patrons and committed many crimes; when exposed he was imprisoned, died in jail, his property was confiscated, and his wife and children were banished.

sentences.zh: 權貴人教其家訟冤，且誣浩以買妾事，言者用是擠之。

translations.literal: Powerful noble taught his family sue injustice, moreover slandered Hao with buying concubine affair, critics used this squeeze him.
translations.idiomatic: The powerful noble had Zheng's family sue for redress and also slandered Hao with a charge of buying a concubine. Critics used this to drive him out.

sentences.zh: 疏方上，權參政劉珙越次奏曰：「李浩為郡，獲罪豪民，為其所誣，臣考其本末甚白。」

translations.literal: Memorial just submitted, Acting Vice Grand Councilor Liu Gong over order memorialized: "Li Hao as prefecture, offended powerful man, by him slandered, minister examined its beginning end very clear."
translations.idiomatic: Just as the memorial was submitted, the Acting Vice Grand Councilor Liu Gong stepped forward out of turn and said: "In governing his prefecture Li Hao offended a powerful man and was slandered by him. Your servant has examined the matter from beginning to end and finds it entirely clear."

sentences.zh: 上顧曰：「守臣不畏強禦，豈易得邪？」

translations.literal: Emperor looked said: "Prefect not fear strong oppression, how easily obtained?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor looked up and said: "A prefect who does not fear the powerful—is he so easily found?"

sentences.zh: 且問章安在，珙袖出之，遂留中不下。

translations.literal: And asked memorial where, Gong sleeve produced it, then kept within not issued.
translations.idiomatic: He then asked where the memorial was. Liu Gong produced it from his sleeve, and the emperor kept it within the palace and did not issue it.

sentences.zh: 大理觀望，猶欲還其所沒貲，上批其後曰：「台州所斷至甚允當，鄭憲家資，永不給還，流徙如故。」

translations.literal: Grand Court of Justice looked on, still wished return his confiscated wealth, emperor annotated after it: "Taizhou judgment extremely fair appropriate, Zheng Xian household assets, forever not return, exile as before."
translations.idiomatic: The Court of the Grand Justice looked on and still wished to return the confiscated property. The emperor annotated the document: "Taizhou's judgment was entirely fair and appropriate. Zheng Xian's household assets shall never be returned, and the exile shall stand as before."

sentences.zh: 浩始得安。

translations.literal: Hao then obtained peace.
translations.idiomatic: Only then was Hao able to rest secure.

sentences.zh: 明年，除司農少卿。

translations.literal: Next year, removed Ministry of Revenue vice director.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷和糴米八萬，董其事者賤糴濕惡，隱克官錢，戶部不敢詰。

translations.literal: Then court harmoniously purchased rice eighty thousand, supervised affair ones cheaply purchased wet bad, secretly deducted official money, Ministry of Revenue not dare investigate.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the court was purchasing eighty thousand piculs of rice under the harmonized-purchase system. Those in charge bought wet and spoiled grain at low prices and secretly pocketed official funds, and the Ministry of Revenue did not dare investigate.

sentences.zh: 浩白發其姦，下有司窮竟。

translations.literal: Hao reported exposed their wickedness, sent down relevant offices thoroughly investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Hao reported and exposed their fraud and ordered the responsible offices to investigate to the end.

sentences.zh: 戶部欲就支稽見數，大理附會之，浩爭曰：「非但惠姦，且虧軍食。」

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue wished settle audit visible numbers, Grand Court of Justice attached followed it, Hao contended: "Not only favor wickedness, moreover short army provisions."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue wished to settle the audit on the visible numbers, and the Court of the Grand Justice went along with this. Hao objected: "This not only favors fraud but also deprives the army of provisions."

sentences.zh: 上是其言。

translations.literal: Emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his view.

sentences.zh: 會大理奏結他獄，上顧輔臣曰：「棘寺官得剛正如李浩者為之。」

translations.literal: Met Grand Court of Justice memorial concluded other case, emperor looked assisting ministers said: "Thorny Temple officials should get firm upright like Li Hao to do it."
translations.idiomatic: When the Court of the Grand Justice memorialized on the conclusion of another case, the emperor looked at his assisting ministers and said: "The Court of the Grand Justice should have someone as firm and upright as Li Hao to head it."

sentences.zh: 已而卿缺，又曰：「無以易浩。」

translations.literal: Soon director vacancy, again said: "None can replace Hao."
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, when the directorship fell vacant, he said again: "No one can replace Hao."

sentences.zh: 遂除大理卿。

translations.literal: Then removed Grand Court of Justice director.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed Director of the Court of the Grand Justice.

sentences.zh: 時上英明，有大有為之志，廷臣不能奉行，誕慢苟且，依違避事。

translations.literal: Then emperor bright wise, had great active intent, court ministers could not carry out, absurd negligent perfunctory, hesitate avoid affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor was bright and wise and had a great resolve to act, yet court ministers could not carry out his will; they were absurd and negligent, perfunctory and evasive.

sentences.zh: 浩前在司農，嘗因面對，陳經理兩淮之策，至是為金使接伴還，奏曰：「臣親見兩淮可耕之田，盡為廢地，心嘗痛之。

translations.literal: Hao formerly in Ministry of Revenue, once by face audience, presented manage Two Huai strategy, to this as Jin envoy reception companion returned, memorialized: "Minister personally saw Two Huai cultivable fields, all became waste land, heart once pained it.
translations.idiomatic: When Hao had previously served in the Ministry of Revenue, he had once presented a plan for managing the Two Huai region in a face audience. Now, returning from serving as reception companion to a Jin envoy, he memorialized: "Your servant personally saw that the cultivable fields of the Two Huai have all become wasteland, and my heart has long been pained by it.

sentences.zh: 條畫營屯，以為恢復根本。」

translations.literal: Itemize plan garrison colonies, take as recovery root foundation."
translations.idiomatic: I have itemized a plan for garrison colonies to serve as the foundation of recovery."

sentences.zh: 又言：「比日措置邊事甚張皇，願戒將吏嚴備禦，無規微利近功。

translations.literal: Again said: "Recent days arrangements border affairs very alarmed, wish warn generals officials strictly prepare defense, not scheme small profit near achievement.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Recently arrangements for border affairs have been unduly alarmist. I beg that generals and officials be warned to prepare defenses strictly and not scheme for small profits and near-term gains.

sentences.zh: 日與大臣修治具，結人心，持重安靜，以俟敵釁。」

translations.literal: Daily with great ministers repair governance tools, bind people's hearts, hold weight calm quiet, to await enemy provocation."
translations.idiomatic: Work daily with the great ministers to repair the instruments of governance, unite the people's hearts, maintain weight and calm, and await the enemy's provocation."

sentences.zh: 上悉嘉納。

translations.literal: Emperor all praised accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted all of this.

sentences.zh: 宰相議遣泛使，浩與辨其不可，至以官職訹之，浩怒，以語觸之，且力求外。

translations.literal: Chancellor discussed send general envoy, Hao with him argued its impossibility, to point with office rank threatened him, Hao angry, with words offended him, moreover forcefully sought outside appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor discussed sending a general envoy. Hao argued with him that it was impossible, and the chancellor even threatened him with his office. Hao grew angry, spoke words that gave offense, and forcefully sought an outside appointment.

sentences.zh: 以直寶文閣知靜江府兼廣西安撫。

translations.literal: With direct Baowen Pavilion know Jingjiang prefecture concurrently Guangxi pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted direct access to the Baowen Pavilion and appointed Prefect of Jingjiang Prefecture and concurrently Pacification Commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 有尚書郎入對，論及擇帥事，上曰：「如廣西，朕已得李浩矣。」

translations.literal: There was Ministry bureau official enter audience, discussed selecting commander affair, emperor said: "Like Guangxi, We already obtained Li Hao."
translations.idiomatic: When a bureau official of the Ministry entered audience and the matter of selecting a commander was discussed, the emperor said: "For Guangxi, I already have Li Hao."

sentences.zh: 又諭大臣曰：「李浩營田議甚可行。」

translations.literal: Again instructed great ministers: "Li Hao garrison field proposal very can implement."
translations.idiomatic: He also instructed the great ministers: "Li Hao's proposal on garrison colonies is very feasible."

sentences.zh: 大臣莫有應者。

translations.literal: Great ministers none had responders.
translations.idiomatic: None of the great ministers responded.

sentences.zh: 浩至郡，舊有靈渠通漕運及灌溉，歲久不治，命疏而通之，民賴其利。

translations.literal: Hao arrived prefecture, formerly had Ling Canal connect grain transport and irrigation, years long not repaired, ordered dredge and open it, people relied on its benefit.
translations.idiomatic: When Hao arrived in the prefecture, he found the old Ling Canal, which served both grain transport and irrigation, had long gone unrepaired. He ordered it dredged and reopened, and the people benefited from it.

sentences.zh: 邕管所隸安平州，其酋恃險，謀聚兵為邊患，浩遣單使諭以禍福，且許其引赦自新，即日叩頭謝過，焚徹水柵，聽太府約束。

translations.literal: Yongguan office subordinate Anping prefecture, its chief relied on danger, plotted gather troops as border trouble, Hao sent lone envoy instructed with fortune disaster, moreover permitted him cite pardon self renew, same day kowtowed thanked fault, burned thoroughly water palisade, listened Grand Treasury restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Anping Prefecture, under Yongguan's jurisdiction, had a tribal chief who relied on the terrain's advantages and plotted to gather troops and become a border menace. Hao sent a lone envoy to instruct him on reward and punishment and promised that if he cited the pardon and reformed himself, he would be accepted. That same day the chief kowtowed in apology, burned his water palisades completely, and submitted to the Grand Treasury's authority.

sentences.zh: 治廣二年，召還，入對，論俗不美者八，其言曰：「陛下所求者規諫，而臣下專務迎合，所貴者執守，而臣下專務順從；

translations.literal: Governed Guang two years, summoned returned, entered audience, discussed customs not beautiful eight, his words said: "Your Majesty seeks remonstrance, yet ministers exclusively pursue flatter comply, what is valued is firm hold, yet ministers exclusively pursue follow obey;
translations.idiomatic: After governing Guangxi for two years he was recalled and entered audience, discussing eight unworthy customs. He said: "What Your Majesty seeks is remonstrance, yet your ministers devote themselves to flattery; what you value is steadfast integrity, yet your ministers devote themselves to compliance;

sentences.zh: 所惜者名器，而僥倖之路未塞；

translations.literal: What is cherished is names vessels, yet lucky bypath not blocked;
translations.idiomatic: what you cherish are titles and offices, yet the path of undeserved favor remains unblocked;

sentences.zh: 所重者廉恥，而趣附之門尚開；

translations.literal: What is heavy is integrity shame, yet rush attach gate still open;
translations.idiomatic: what you esteem is integrity and shame, yet the door to fawning attachment remains open;

sentences.zh: 儒術可行，而有險詖之徒；

translations.literal: Confucian arts can be practiced, yet have dangerous biased ones;
translations.idiomatic: Confucian learning can be put into practice, yet there are men of dangerous bias;

sentences.zh: 下情當盡，而有壅蔽之患；

translations.literal: Lower sentiments should be exhausted, yet have obstruction covering trouble;
translations.idiomatic: the sentiments of those below should be fully heard, yet there is the trouble of obstruction;

sentences.zh: 期以氣節，而偷惰者得以苟容；

translations.literal: Expect by moral fiber, yet lazy ones obtain temporary tolerance;
translations.idiomatic: you expect moral fiber, yet the lazy and negligent are allowed to remain;

sentences.zh: 責以實效，而誕慢者得以自售。」

translations.literal: Charge with real effect, yet absurd negligent ones obtain self sell."
translations.idiomatic: you demand real results, yet the absurd and negligent are able to sell themselves."

sentences.zh: 上問誕慢謂誰，浩具以實對。

translations.literal: Emperor asked absurd negligent means who, Hao fully with facts replied.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked whom he meant by the absurd and negligent, and Hao answered fully and truthfully.

sentences.zh: 翌日，謂宰相曰：「李浩直諒。」

translations.literal: Next day, said chancellor: "Li Hao straight sincere."
translations.idiomatic: The next day he said to the chancellor: "Li Hao is upright and sincere."

sentences.zh: 遂除權吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Then removed acting Ministry of Personnel vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed Acting Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 時政府有怙寵竊權者，黨與非一，自浩之入，已相側目，且欲以甘言誘之，浩中立不倚，拒弗納。

translations.literal: Then government had rely favor steal power ones, faction associates not one, from Hao's entry, already mutually sidelong eyes, moreover wished with sweet words entice him, Hao neutral not lean, refused not accept.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there were men in the government who relied on favor to usurp power, and their faction was not small. From the time Hao entered office they already looked askance at him and wished to entice him with smooth words. Hao stood neutral and uncommitted and refused to accept.

sentences.zh: 於是相與謀嗾諫議大夫姚憲論浩以強狠之資，挾奸諛之志，置之近列，變亂黑白。

translations.literal: Therefore together plotted instigate Remonstrance and Discussion Grand Master Yao Xian criticize Hao with strong harsh nature, carry wicked flattery intent, place him near ranks, change confuse black white.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore plotted together and had the Remonstrance and Discussion Grand Master Yao Xian attack Hao as one of harsh and overbearing temperament who harbors a wicked desire to flatter, and as one whose placement in high office confuses right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 未及正謝而罷。

translations.literal: Not yet reached formal thanks then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could formally thank the emperor for his appointment, he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乾道九年，提舉太平興國宮。

translations.literal: Qiandao ninth year, supervisor Taiping Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of the Qiandao reign he was made Supervisor of the Taiping Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，夔路闕帥，命浩以秘閣修撰寵其行。

translations.literal: Next year summer, Kuizhou circuit lacked commander, ordered Hao with Secret Pavilion compiler honor his journey.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer the Kuizhou circuit lacked a commander, and Hao was appointed with the title of Compiler of the Secret Pavilion to honor his departure.

sentences.zh: 夔有羈縻州曰思州，世襲為守則田氏，與其猶子不協，將起兵相攻，浩草檄遣官為勸解，二人感悟，歃血盟，盡釋前憾，邊得以寧。

translations.literal: Kuizhou had attached pacified prefecture called Sizhou, hereditary as prefect then Tian clan, with his nephew's son not harmonious, about to raise troops mutually attack, Hao drafted proclamation sent official as mediator persuade resolve, two men moved awakened, blood oath alliance, completely released former resentment, border obtained peace.
translations.idiomatic: In Kuizhou there was an attached-and-pacified prefecture called Sizhou, hereditarily held by the Tian clan. The Tian chief and his nephew's son were at odds and were about to raise troops against each other. Hao drafted a proclamation and sent an official to mediate. The two men were moved to repentance, swore a blood oath, completely released their former grievances, and the border was thereby pacified.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以疾請祠，提舉玉隆萬壽宮，命未至，以淳熙三年九月卒，年六十一。

translations.literal: Over year, because illness requested temple, superintendent Yulong Wanshou Palace, order not yet arrive, on Chunxi third year ninth month died, age sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year, he requested a temple post on grounds of illness and was appointed superintendent of the Yulong Wanshou Palace, but before the order arrived he died in the ninth month of the third year of the Chunxi reign, at the age of sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 諸司奏浩盡瘁其職以死，詔特贈集英殿修撰。

translations.literal: Various offices memorialized Hao exhausted office to death, edict specially posthumously granted Jiying Hall compiler.
translations.idiomatic: The various offices reported that Hao had worn himself out in office until death, and an edict specially posthumously granted him the title of compiler at the Hall for Assembling Excellence.

sentences.zh: 浩天資質直，涵養渾厚，不以利害動其心。

translations.literal: Hao heaven-endowed nature upright, cultivation deep and thick, not by benefit harm move his heart.
translations.idiomatic: Hao was upright by nature, deeply cultivated in character, and never swayed in his heart by considerations of gain or loss.

sentences.zh: 少力學為文辭，及壯益沈潛理義。

translations.literal: Youth vigorously studied to make literary compositions, when mature more deeply immersed in principle and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he studied hard and cultivated literary composition; in maturity he immersed himself ever more deeply in principle and moral reasoning.

sentences.zh: 立朝慨然以時事為己任，忠憤激烈，言切時弊，以此見忌於眾。

translations.literal: Stood at court sighing took current affairs as own responsibility, loyal indignation fierce, words cut current abuses, by this seen as hated by many.
translations.idiomatic: At court he took current affairs upon himself with passionate resolve, his loyal indignation was fierce, and his words cut to the abuses of the age; for this he was widely resented.

sentences.zh: 平居未嘗假人以辭色，不知者以為傲，或譖於上前，上謂：「斯人無他，在朕前亦如此，非為傲者。」

translations.literal: In daily life never lent others words and countenance, those not knowing thought arrogant, some slandered before emperor, emperor said: "This man has nothing else, before Us also thus, not one who is arrogant."
translations.idiomatic: In daily life he never put on a pleasant face for others; those who did not know him took this for arrogance, and some slandered him before the emperor. The emperor said, "This man has no other motive—in Our presence he is the same. He is not being arrogant."

sentences.zh: 小人憚之，誘以祿利，正色不回，謀害之者無所不至，獨賴上察其衷，始終全之。

translations.literal: Petty men feared him, tempted with salary and profit, correct countenance not turning, those plotting harm to him nothing not reaching, alone relied on emperor discerning his inner mind, from beginning to end preserved him.
translations.idiomatic: Petty men feared him and tried to lure him with salary and profit, but he maintained a stern countenance and would not bend; those who plotted against him stopped at nothing. He owed his preservation throughout to the emperor's discernment of his true heart.

sentences.zh: 為郡尤潔己，自海右歸，不載南海一物。

translations.literal: As prefect especially pure himself, from sea west returned, not carried South Sea one thing.
translations.idiomatic: As a prefect he was especially strict with himself; when he returned from the southern coast he brought back not a single thing from the South Sea.

sentences.zh: 平生奉養如布衣時，風裁素高，人不敢干以私云。

translations.literal: Whole life supported himself as common cloth time, style and restraint always high, people not dare approach with private matters it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his life he maintained the same standard of living as when he was a commoner; his bearing had always been lofty, and it is said that people did not dare approach him with private requests.

sentences.zh: 陳橐，字德應，紹興餘姚人。

translations.literal: Chen Tuo, courtesy name Deying, Shaoxing Yuyao person.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tuo, courtesy name Deying, was a native of Yuyao in Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 入太學有聲，登政和上舍第，教授寧州。

translations.literal: Entered Imperial Academy had reputation, passed Zhenghe upper-house rank, instructor Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Imperial Academy with a growing reputation, passed the upper-house examination in the Zhenghe reign, and served as instructor at Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 以母老改台州士曹，治獄平允。

translations.literal: Because mother old changed to Taizhou shicao, governed prisons fair and even.
translations.idiomatic: Because his mother was elderly, he transferred to the post of shicao at Taizhou, where he handled legal cases with fairness.

sentences.zh: 更攝天臺、臨海、黃岩三邑，易越州新昌令，皆以愷悌稱。

translations.literal: Further acted for Tiantai, Linhai, Huangyan three districts, changed to Yuezhou Xinchang magistrate, all by kind and gentle praised.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served in an acting capacity over the three districts of Tiantai, Linhai, and Huangyan, and then became magistrate of Xinchang in Yuezhou; in every post he was praised for kindness and gentleness.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩欲援為御史，約先一見，橐曰：「宰相用人，乃使之呈身耶？」

translations.literal: Lu Yihao wished to support as censor, arranged first one meeting, Tuo said: "Prime minister employs men, yet makes them present themselves?"
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao wished to recommend him as censor and arranged to meet him first. Tuo said, "When a prime minister employs men, must he make them come forward and present themselves?"

sentences.zh: 謝不往。

translations.literal: Declined and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: He declined and did not go.

sentences.zh: 趙鼎、李光交薦其才。

translations.literal: Zhao Ding, Li Guang mutually recommended his talent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ding and Li Guang both recommended his talent.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年五月，召對，改秩。

translations.literal: Shaoxing second year fifth month, summoned for audience, changed rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of the Shaoxing reign he was summoned for an audience and his rank was changed.

sentences.zh: 六月，除監察御史，論事不合。

translations.literal: Sixth month, removed as investigating censor, discussed affairs not agree.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was appointed investigating censor, but his views on affairs did not accord with those in power.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔以宰邑有治行，除江西運判。

translations.literal: Eighth month, edict because governing district had governing conduct, removed as Jiangxi transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an edict noted his record of good governance as a district magistrate and appointed him transport commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 瑞昌令倚勢受賂，橐首劾罷之。

translations.literal: Ruichang magistrate relied on power received bribes, Tuo first impeached and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate of Ruichang relied on influence to accept bribes; Tuo was the first to impeach and have him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 期年，所按以十數，至有望風解印綬者。

translations.literal: Full year, those investigated numbered in tens, even to those who at sight of wind removed seal cords.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year he investigated more than ten cases, and some officials even resigned their posts at the mere rumor of his approach.

sentences.zh: 以母年高，乞歸養，詔橐善撫字，移知台州。

translations.literal: Because mother age high, begged return to support, edict Tuo good in nurturing people, transferred to know Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because his mother was advanced in years, he requested leave to return and support her; an edict praised Tuo's skill in caring for the people and transferred him to serve as prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 台有五邑，嘗攝其三，民懷惠愛，越境歡迎，不數月稱治。

translations.literal: Tai had five districts, once acted for three of them, people cherished benevolence and love, crossed borders joyfully welcomed, within few months called well governed.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou had five districts, and he had once served in an acting capacity over three of them; the people cherished his kindness, welcomed him across district borders, and within a few months his rule was acclaimed.

sentences.zh: 母喪，邦人巷哭，相率走行在所者千餘人，請起橐。

translations.literal: Mother mourning, state people alleys wept, together leading rushed to temporary residence over thousand people, requested recall Tuo.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died the people of the prefecture wept in the alleys, and more than a thousand of them went together to the emperor's temporary residence to request that Tuo be recalled to office.

sentences.zh: 詔橐清謹不擾，治狀著聞，其敕所在州賜錢三十萬。

translations.literal: Edict Tuo pure careful not disturbing, governing record famous and heard, ordered his prefecture grant money three hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Tuo as pure, careful, and unobtrusive, noted that his record of governance was widely known, and ordered his prefecture to grant him three hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 橐力辭，上謂近臣曰：「陳橐有古循吏風。」

translations.literal: Tuo forcefully declined, emperor told close ministers said: "Chen Tuo has ancient virtuous official wind."
translations.idiomatic: Tuo forcefully declined. The emperor told his close ministers, "Chen Tuo has the bearing of the virtuous officials of old."

sentences.zh: 終喪，以司勳郎中召。

translations.literal: Mourning ended, with Bureau of Merit langzhong summoned.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended he was summoned as langzhong in the Bureau of Merit.

sentences.zh: 累遷權刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted acting vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to acting vice minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 時秦檜力主和議，橐疏謂：「金人多詐，和不可信。

translations.literal: At time Qin Hui strongly advocated peace talks, Tuo memorial said: "Jin people much deceit, peace not trustworthy.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Qin Hui strongly advocated peace talks. Tuo submitted a memorial saying, "The Jin are much given to deceit, and peace cannot be trusted.
