sentences.zh: 且二聖遠狩沙漠，百姓肝腦塗地，天下痛心疾首。

translations.literal: Moreover two emperors far hunted in desert sands, common people livers brains smeared on ground, all under heaven pained heart and aching head.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the two emperors are far off in the desert sands, the common people have been slaughtered until the ground is soaked with blood, and all under Heaven are heartsick and furious.

sentences.zh: 今天意既回，兵勢漸集，宜乘時掃清，以雪國恥；

translations.literal: Now heaven's intent already turned, military strength gradually gathered, ought seize time sweep clean, to wipe national shame;
translations.idiomatic: Now that Heaven's intent has turned and military strength is gradually gathering, we ought to seize the moment to sweep the enemy away and wipe out the nation's shame;

sentences.zh: 否亦當按兵嚴備，審勢而動。

translations.literal: If not also ought hold troops strict preparations, examine situation then move.
translations.idiomatic: if not, we should at least hold our troops in readiness with strict defenses and act only after weighing the situation.

sentences.zh: 舍此不為，乃遽講和，何以繫中原之望。」

translations.literal: Abandon this not doing, yet hastily discuss peace, with what tie Central Plains hope."
translations.idiomatic: To abandon this and instead rush into peace talks—how can that sustain the hopes of the Central Plains?"

sentences.zh: 既而金厚有所邀，議久不決，將再遣使，橐復言：「金每挾講和以售其姦謀。

translations.literal: Soon after Jin heavily had demands, deliberation long not decided, about to again send envoys, Tuo again said: "Jin each time uses peace talks to sell their treacherous schemes.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Jin made heavy demands and deliberations dragged on without decision; as the court was about to send envoys again, Tuo spoke once more: "The Jin always use peace talks to advance their treacherous schemes.

sentences.zh: 論者因其廢劉豫又還河南地，遂謂其有意於和，臣以為不然。

translations.literal: Discussants because they deposed Liu Yu and also returned Henan lands, then said they had intent toward peace, subject thought not so.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators, seeing that the Jin had deposed Liu Yu and returned the lands of Henan, concluded that they were sincere about peace, but I do not think so.

sentences.zh: 且金之立豫，蓋欲自為捍蔽，使之南窺。

translations.literal: Moreover Jin's establishing Yu, probably wished self make shield and barrier, make him south spy.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in establishing Yu the Jin intended to create a shield for themselves and have him probe southward.

sentences.zh: 豫每犯順，率皆敗北，金知不足恃，從而廢之，豈為我哉？

translations.literal: Yu each time violated obedience, mostly all defeated north, Jin knew not enough to rely on, followed and deposed him, how for us?
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Yu rebelled he was invariably defeated; once the Jin knew he could not be relied upon, they deposed him. Was that done for our sake?

sentences.zh: 河南之地欲付之他人，則必以豫為戒，故捐以歸我。

translations.literal: Henan lands wished entrust to others, then must take Yu as warning, therefore donated to return to us.
translations.idiomatic: If they wished to entrust the lands of Henan to someone else, they would surely take Yu as a warning, and so they relinquished the territory to us.

sentences.zh: 往歲金書嘗謂歲帑多寡聽我所裁，曾未淹歲，反覆如此。

translations.literal: Past years Jin letter once said yearly treasury more or less listen to our decision, not yet full year passed, reversed and repeated thus.
translations.idiomatic: In past years a Jin letter once said that the size of the annual tribute would be left to our decision, yet before a full year had passed they reversed themselves in this way.

sentences.zh: 且割地通和，則彼此各守封疆可也，而同州之橋，至今存焉。

translations.literal: Moreover ceding land to communicate peace, then each side guard borders would suffice, yet Tongzhou bridge until now still exists.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, if peace through ceded territory means that each side keeps to its own borders, that would be acceptable—yet the bridge at Tongzhou still stands to this day.

sentences.zh: 蓋金非可以義交而信結，恐其假和好之說，騁謬悠之辭，包藏禍心，變出不測。

translations.literal: Probably Jin not can by righteousness associate and by trust bind, fear they borrow good harmony talk, gallop absurd distant words, conceal treacherous heart, change emerge unforeseen.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin cannot be bound by righteousness and good faith; I fear they will use talk of amity to spin absurd and empty words, conceal treacherous intent, and strike with unforeseen changes.

sentences.zh: 願深鑒前轍，亦嚴戰守之備，使人人激厲，常若寇至。

translations.literal: Wish deeply mirror previous track, also strict battle defense preparations, make every person roused and sharp, always as if invaders arrive.
translations.idiomatic: I wish that we deeply take warning from past mistakes and also tighten our preparations for war and defense, rousing every man so that we are always as if the enemy were at the gates.

sentences.zh: 苟彼通和，則吾之振飭武備不害為立國之常。

translations.literal: If they communicate peace, then our strengthening military preparations not harm as establishing state's constant.
translations.idiomatic: If they do seek peace, then our strengthening of military readiness would still be no more than the constant duty of sustaining a state.

sentences.zh: 如其不然，決意恢復之圖，勿循私曲之說，天意允協，人心響應，一舉以成大勳，則梓宮、太后可還，祖宗疆土可復矣。」

translations.literal: If not so, resolve recovery plan, do not follow private crooked talk, heaven's intent accord, people's hearts respond, one effort to complete great merit, then imperial coffin, empress dowager can return, ancestral temple territory can recover."
translations.idiomatic: If that is not the case, then resolve on a plan of recovery and do not follow partisan and crooked counsel. When Heaven's intent accords and the people's hearts respond, one stroke can achieve great merit—the imperial coffin and the empress dowager can be brought back, and the territory of our ancestors can be restored."

sentences.zh: 檜憾之。

translations.literal: Hui resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Hui resented this.

sentences.zh: 橐因力請去。

translations.literal: Tuo therefore forcefully requested leave.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo therefore forcefully requested to leave office.

sentences.zh: 未幾，金果渝盟。

translations.literal: Not long after, Jin indeed violated alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Jin did indeed break the treaty.

sentences.zh: 除徽猷閣待制、知潁昌府。

translations.literal: Removed as Huayou Hall attendant draft, know Yingchang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed attendant draft at the Hall of Splendid Learning and prefect of Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 時河南新疆初復，無敢往者，橐即日就道。

translations.literal: At time Henan newly regained just restored, none dared go, Tuo same day set out on road.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Henan had just been newly recovered and no one dared go there, but Tuo set out the same day.

sentences.zh: 次壽春則潁已不守。

translations.literal: Stopped at Shouchun then Ying already not held.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Shouchun, Ying was already lost.

sentences.zh: 改處州，又改廣州。

translations.literal: Changed to Chuzhou, again changed to Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Chuzhou, and then again to Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 兵興後，廣東盜賊無寧歲，十年九易牧守。

translations.literal: After warfare arose, Guangdong bandits no peaceful year, ten years nine times changed prefects.
translations.idiomatic: After the outbreak of war Guangdong knew no year free of bandits, and in ten years prefects were changed nine times.

sentences.zh: 橐盡革弊政，以恩先之。

translations.literal: Tuo completely reformed bad policies, with kindness first them.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo thoroughly reformed corrupt policies and led with kindness.

sentences.zh: 留鎮三年，民夷悅服。

translations.literal: Remained garrison three years, people and barbarians pleased and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He remained in command for three years, and both the people and the tribal groups were pleased and submitted.

sentences.zh: 初，朝廷移韓京一軍屯循州，會郴寇駱科犯廣西，詔遣京討之。

translations.literal: Initially, court moved Han Jing one army garrisoned Xunzhou, coinciding Chen bandit Luo Ke invaded Guangxi, edict sent Jing to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the court had moved one army under Han Jing to garrison Xunzhou. When the Chen bandit Luo Ke invaded Guangxi, an edict ordered Jing to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 橐奏：「廣東累年困於寇賊，自京移屯，敵稍知畏。

translations.literal: Tuo memorialized: "Guangdong successive years trapped by bandits, since Jing moved garrison, enemy slightly knew fear.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo submitted a memorial: "Guangdong has for years been harried by bandits; since Jing's garrison was moved here, the enemy have somewhat learned to fear us.

sentences.zh: 今悉軍赴廣西，則廣東危矣。」

translations.literal: Now all army goes to Guangxi, then Guangdong in danger."
translations.idiomatic: If the entire army is now sent to Guangxi, Guangdong will be in peril."

sentences.zh: 檜以橐為京地，坐稽留機事，降秩。

translations.literal: Hui because Tuo was Jing's territory, charged delaying critical affairs, reduced rank.
translations.idiomatic: Hui, taking Tuo to be acting in Jing's interest, charged him with delaying critical affairs and reduced his rank.

sentences.zh: 屢上章告老，改婺州，請不已，遂致仕。

translations.literal: Repeatedly submitted memorials announcing retirement, changed to Wuzhou, requests not stopping, then retired.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly submitted memorials requesting retirement, was transferred to Wuzhou, and when his requests did not cease he finally retired from office.

sentences.zh: 又十二年，以疾卒於家，年六十六。

translations.literal: Again twelve years, because illness died at home, age sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve years later he died of illness at home, at the age of sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 橐博學剛介，不事產業，先世田廬，悉推予兄弟。

translations.literal: Tuo broad learning firm and upright, not engaged in estates, ancestral fields and houses, all pushed to give brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo was broadly learned and firm in character; he did not pursue estates, and the fields and houses of his forebears he gave entirely to his brothers.

sentences.zh: 在廣積年，四方聘幣一不入私室。

translations.literal: At Guang many years accumulated, four directions employment gifts not one entered private room.
translations.idiomatic: During his many years in Guangzhou not a single gift of employment from any quarter entered his private quarters.

sentences.zh: 既謝事歸剡中，僑寓僧寺，日糴以食，處之泰然。

translations.literal: Already left office returned to Shanzhong, sojourned lodged in monk temple, daily bought grain to eat, treated it calmly.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving office he returned to Shan and lodged in a monastery, buying grain each day for food, and bore it all with calm equanimity.

sentences.zh: 王十朋為《風土賦》，論近世會稽人物，曰：「杜祁公之後有陳德應」云。

translations.literal: Wang Shipeng wrote "Local Customs Rhapsody," discussed recent Kuaiji figures, said: "After Duke Du of Qi there is Chen Deying" it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shipeng, in his Rhapsody on Local Customs, discussing recent figures of Kuaiji, said, "After Duke Du of Qi there is Chen Deying," it is said.

sentences.zh: 胡沂，字周伯，紹興餘姚人。

translations.literal: Hu Yi, courtesy name Zhoubo, Shaoxing Yuyao person.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yi, courtesy name Zhoubo, was a native of Yuyao in Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 父宗伋，號醇儒，能守所學，不逐時好。

translations.literal: Father Zongji, styled Pure Scholar, able guard what studied, not follow current fashions.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zongji, styled the Pure Scholar, was able to hold to what he had learned and did not chase the fashions of the day.

sentences.zh: 沂穎異，六歲誦《五經》皆畢，不忘一字。

translations.literal: Yi outstanding and unusual, six years recited Five Classics all completed, not forgot one character.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was precocious; at six he had recited all of the Five Classics and forgot not a single character.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年進士甲科，陸沉州縣幾三十載，至二十八年，始入為正字。

translations.literal: Shaoxing fifth year jinshi first rank, sunk in prefecture and county nearly thirty years, until twenty-eighth year, first entered as corrector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Shaoxing reign he passed the jinshi examination in the first rank, then languished in prefecture and county posts for nearly thirty years until the twenty-eighth year, when he first entered the capital as a corrector.

sentences.zh: 遷校書郎兼實錄院檢討官，吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: Promoted collator concurrently Veritable Records Academy reviser, Ministry of Personnel vice director.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to collator and concurrently reviser at the Academy of Veritable Records, and then to vice director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 轉右司，以憂去，終喪還朝。

translations.literal: Transferred to Right Office, because mourning left, mourning ended returned court.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Right Office, left on account of mourning, and after his mourning ended returned to court.

sentences.zh: 孝宗受禪，除國子司業、鄧王府直講，尋擢殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Xiaozong received abdication, removed as Directorate of Education vice director, Deng Prince mansion direct lecturer, soon promoted Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong received the abdication, Yi was appointed vice director of the Directorate of Education and direct lecturer at the mansion of Prince Deng, and was soon promoted to palace censor.

sentences.zh: 有旨侍從、臺諫條具方今時務，沂言：「守禦之利，莫若令沿邊屯田。

translations.literal: Had decree attendant ministers, censors itemize present current affairs, Yi said: "Defense advantage, none better than order frontier garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered attendant ministers and censors to itemize current affairs. Yi said, "For defense there is nothing better than ordering garrison farming along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 前歲淮民逃移，未復舊業，中原歸附，未知所處。

translations.literal: Previous years Huai people fled and moved, not restored old occupations, Central Plains submitted, not known where placed.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the people of the Huai region fled and have not restored their old occupations, and those who have submitted from the Central Plains do not yet know where they will be settled.

sentences.zh: 俾之就耕，可贍給，省餉饋。

translations.literal: Make them take up farming, can support supply, save rations sent.
translations.idiomatic: If they are made to take up farming, they can support themselves and the cost of supplying rations can be saved.

sentences.zh: 東作方興，且慮敵人乘時驚擾，宜聚兵險隘防守。」

translations.literal: Eastern work just rising, also worry enemy seize time alarm and disturb, ought gather troops at dangerous passes defend."
translations.idiomatic: Spring planting is just beginning, and we should also worry that the enemy may seize the moment to raid and disturb us; troops should be gathered at strategic passes for defense."

sentences.zh: 詔行其言。

translations.literal: Edict carried out his words.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that his proposal be carried out.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞辛次膺論殿帥成閔黷貨不恤士卒之罪，詔罷殿前司職事，與祠。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Xin Ciying discussed Palace Commander Cheng Min embezzlement not caring for soldiers crime, edict dismissed Palace Front Office duties, granted temple post.
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief Xin Ciying charged the palace commander Cheng Min with embezzlement and neglect of his soldiers; an edict dismissed him from duties at the Palace Front Office and granted him a temple post.

sentences.zh: 沂再言其二十罪，遂落太尉，婺州居住。

translations.literal: Yi again spoke his twenty crimes, then stripped Grand Marshal, Wuzhou residence.
translations.idiomatic: Yi again listed twenty crimes against him, whereupon Cheng was stripped of the rank of grand marshal and ordered to reside at Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 沂又言：「將臣定十等之目，令其舉薦，施之擇將之頃則可，施之養士有素則未也。

translations.literal: Yi again said: "General ministers fixed ten-rank categories, ordered them recommend, applying at moment of selecting generals then acceptable, applying to long-nurtured officers then not yet.
translations.idiomatic: Yi also said, "To fix ten ranks for generals and order recommendations may be acceptable when selecting commanders, but it is not yet suited to officers who have been trained over time.

sentences.zh: 夫設武舉，立武學，試之以弓馬，又試之以韜略之文、兵機之策，蓋將有所用也。

translations.literal: Now establishing military examination, establishing military academy, tested them with bow and horse, again tested with strategy texts and military tactics plans, probably intending to have use.
translations.idiomatic: Military examinations and military academies were established, candidates were tested in archery and horsemanship and again in texts on strategy and plans of military tactics—all evidently so that they might be put to use.

sentences.zh: 除高等一二名，餘皆吏部授以榷酤、征商，所養非所用，所用非所養，願詔大臣詳議，中舉者定品格，分差邊將下準備差遣，則人人思奮，應上之求矣。」

translations.literal: Except top one or two names, rest all Ministry of Personnel assigned salt monopoly and tax collection, what nurtured not what used, what used not what nurtured, wish edict great ministers detailed discussion, those passing examination fix grades, separately assigned under frontier generals as reserve dispatch, then every man thinks to strive, respond to superiors' requests."
translations.idiomatic: Apart from the one or two top graduates, the rest are all assigned by the Ministry of Personnel to salt monopolies and tax collection—the men trained are not those employed, and those employed are not those trained. I wish that an edict would order the great ministers to discuss this in detail, fix grades for examination graduates, and assign them as reserve officers under frontier generals; then every man would strive to excel and respond to what the throne seeks."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 時龍大淵、曾覿以藩邸舊恩除知閤門事，張震、劉珙、周必大相繼繳回詞命。

translations.literal: At time Long Dayuan, Zeng Di because princely mansion old favor removed as Gate Affairs manager, Zhang Zhen, Liu Guo, Zhou Bida successively returned sealed edicts.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Long Dayuan and Zeng Di were appointed managers of gate affairs on account of old favor from the princely mansion; Zhang Zhen, Liu Guo, and Zhou Bida successively returned the sealed edicts in protest.

sentences.zh: 沂論其市權招士，請屏遠之，未聽，而諫官劉度坐抗論左遷。

translations.literal: Yi discussed their trading power to recruit scholars, requested remove them far away, not listened, while remonstrating official Liu Du sat opposing discussion demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Yi argued that they traded on power to recruit followers and requested that they be removed far from court; the request was not heeded, and the remonstrating official Liu Du was demoted for his outspoken opposition.

sentences.zh: 沂累章，益懇切，曰：「大淵、覿不屏去，安知無柳宗元、劉禹錫輩撓節以從之者。」

translations.literal: Yi repeated memorials, more earnest, said: "Dayuan, Di not removed far, how know no Liu Zongyuan, Liu Yuxi sort bending integrity to follow them."
translations.idiomatic: Yi submitted repeated memorials, ever more earnest, saying, "If Dayuan and Di are not removed, how can we know that there will not be men like Liu Zongyuan and Liu Yuxi who bend their integrity to follow them?"

sentences.zh: 好進者嫉其言，共排之，沂亦以言不行請去，遂以直顯謨閣主管台州崇道觀。

translations.literal: Those seeking advancement jealous of his words, together expelled him, Yi also because words not carried out requested leave, then with direct Xianmo Hall supervised Taizhou Chongdao Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Those eager for advancement resented his words and combined to drive him out; Yi also requested leave because his advice was not followed, and was then appointed direct attendant at the Hall of Manifest Counsel to supervise the Chongdao Abbey at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年冬，召為宗正少卿兼皇子慶王府贊讀，尋兼侍講，進中書舍人、給事中。

translations.literal: Qiandao first year winter, summoned as Director of the Imperial Clan vice director concurrently Prince Qing mansion reader, soon concurrently lecturer, advanced Secretariat drafter, Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of the Qiandao reign he was summoned as vice director of the Directorate of the Imperial Clan and concurrently reader at the mansion of Prince Qing, soon also lecturer, and was advanced to drafter of the Secretariat and supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 進對，論命令當謹之於造命之初，上曰：「三代盛時如此。

translations.literal: Advanced audience, discussed commands ought be careful at beginning of issuing orders, emperor said: "Three Dynasties flourishing age thus.
translations.idiomatic: At an audience he argued that commands ought to be treated with care at the very moment they are issued. The emperor said, "It was so in the flourishing age of the Three Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 卿職在繳駁，事有當然，勿謂拂君相不言。」

translations.literal: Your duty in returning sealed edicts, matters having what is right, do not think opposing ruler and minister not speak."
translations.idiomatic: Your duty lies in returning sealed edicts when matters require it; do not think that opposing the ruler and minister means you should keep silent."

sentences.zh: 除吏部侍郎兼權尚書。

translations.literal: Removed as Ministry of Personnel vice minister concurrently acting minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice minister of Personnel and concurrently acting minister.

sentences.zh: 沂奏：「七司法自紹興十三年纂修成書，歲且一紀，歷月閱時，不無牴牾。

translations.literal: Yi memorialized: "Seven-branch statutes since Shaoxing thirteenth year compiled completed book, years nearly one cycle, passing months reviewing time, not without contradictions.
translations.idiomatic: Yi submitted a memorial: "The statutes of the seven offices, compiled and completed in the thirteenth year of the Shaoxing reign, have now nearly reached a full cycle of years; as months and seasons have passed, contradictions have inevitably arisen.

sentences.zh: 望令敕令所官討論章旨，此法可行不可行，此條當革不當革，將見行之法與當革之條輯為一書，頒之中外，庶可戢吏胥之姦。」

translations.literal: Wish order Edicts and Decrees Office officials discuss chapter intent, this law practicable or not practicable, this article ought reform or not ought reform, will current laws and articles ought reform compile as one book, promulgate within and without, perhaps can restrain clerks and runners' treachery."
translations.idiomatic: I wish that officials of the Office of Edicts and Decrees be ordered to discuss the intent of each chapter, determine which laws are practicable and which are not, which articles ought to be reformed and which ought not, compile the laws now in force together with the articles due for reform into one book, and promulgate it within and without the court, so that the treachery of clerks and runners may be curbed."

sentences.zh: 詔行之。

translations.literal: Edict carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that it be carried out.

sentences.zh: 尋以目疾丐祠。

translations.literal: Soon because eye illness begged temple post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he requested a temple post on account of eye disease.

sentences.zh: 六年，出為徽猷閣待制、知處州。

translations.literal: Sixth year, out as Huayou Hall attendant draft, know Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was sent out as attendant draft at the Hall of Splendid Learning and prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 復引疾奉祠，提舉江州太平興國宮。

translations.literal: Again cited illness received temple post, superintendent Jiangzhou Taiping Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He again cited illness and received a temple post as superintendent of the Taiping Xingguo Palace at Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，以待制除太子詹事，尋復拜給事中，進禮部尚書並兼領詹事，又改侍讀。

translations.literal: Eighth year, with attendant draft removed as Crown Prince tutor, soon again appointed Supervising Secretary, advanced Minister of Rites and concurrently leading tutor, again changed to reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed crown prince tutor with the rank of attendant draft, was soon again appointed supervising secretary, was advanced to minister of rites while concurrently retaining the tutorship, and was then changed to reader.

sentences.zh: 上顧沂厚，有大用意，而沂資性恬退，無所依附，數請去。

translations.literal: Emperor looked on Yi generously, had great intended use, yet Yi natural disposition calm and retiring, without relying on attachment, repeatedly requested leave.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor regarded Yi with great favor and had large designs for him, but Yi's disposition was calm and retiring and he relied on no faction; he repeatedly requested to leave office.

sentences.zh: 虞允文當國，希旨建策復中原，沂極論金無畔，而我諸將未見可任此事者，數梗其議。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen held state, seeking intent proposed strategy recover Central Plains, Yi extremely argued Jin no rebellion, yet our various generals not seen able to undertake this matter, repeatedly obstructed his deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu Yunwen held power he sought favor by proposing a strategy to recover the Central Plains; Yi argued forcefully that the Jin had not rebelled and that none of our generals yet appeared capable of undertaking such a task, and repeatedly blocked the proposal.

sentences.zh: 遂以龍圖閣學士仍提舉興國宮。

translations.literal: Then with Dragon Diagram Hall academician still superintendent Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed academician at the Hall of Dragon Diagram while still serving as superintendent of the Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年卒，年六十八。

translations.literal: Chunxi first year died, age sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of the Chunxi reign, at the age of sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 方疾革，整容素冠不少惰，蓋其為學所得者如此。

translations.literal: Just illness critical, arranged countenance plain cap not slightly slack, probably his learning attained thus.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness turned critical he still composed his bearing and wore plain mourning cap without the least slackness—such was what his learning had made of him.

sentences.zh: 諡「獻肅」。

translations.literal: Posthumous title "Xiansu."
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Xiansu.

sentences.zh: 唐文若

translations.literal: Tang Wenruo
translations.idiomatic: Tang Wenruo

sentences.zh: 唐文若，字立夫，眉山人。

translations.literal: Tang Wenruo, courtesy name Lifu, Meishan person.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Wenruo, courtesy name Lifu, was a native of Meishan.

sentences.zh: 父庚在《文苑傳》。

translations.literal: Father Geng in "Literary Garden Biographies."
translations.idiomatic: His father Geng is treated in the Literary Garden Biographies.

sentences.zh: 文若少英邁不群，為文豪健。

translations.literal: Wenruo youth outstanding and surpassing others, made writing bold and strong.
translations.idiomatic: Wenruo in youth was outstanding and stood apart from others; his writing was bold and vigorous.

sentences.zh: 登進士第，分教潼川府。

translations.literal: Passed jinshi rank, assigned to teach Tongchuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and was assigned to teach at Tongchuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 給事中勾濤薦自代，詔赴行在所，既至，而勾濤出，不得見。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Gou Tao recommended to replace himself, edict go to temporary residence, already arrived, yet Gou Tao left, not obtain audience.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising secretary Gou Tao recommended him as his own successor and an edict ordered him to proceed to the temporary residence; when he arrived, however, Gou Tao had already left office and he could not obtain an audience.

sentences.zh: 文若奏書闕下，略曰：「昔漢高慢士，四皓去之，而西鄙少廉恥之人；

translations.literal: Wenruo memorialized book at palace gate, summary said: "Formerly Han Gaozu slighted scholars, four hoary ones left him, and western borderlands had few people of integrity and shame;
translations.idiomatic: Wenruo submitted a memorial to the throne, saying in summary, "In former times Emperor Gaozu of Han slighted scholars, the Four White-Haired Elders left him, and the western borderlands had few men of integrity and shame;

sentences.zh: 光武禮賢，嚴光友之，而東都多節義之士。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu honored worthies, Yan Guang befriended him, and Eastern Capital had many men of integrity and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu honored worthy men and treated Yan Guang as a friend, and the Eastern Capital had many men of integrity and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 陛下屈萬乘之尊，駐蹕東南，兩宮將歸，五路初復，正宜市朽骨，式怒蛙，以來豪傑，與之共治，寧遽惜此數刻之對耶？」

translations.literal: Your Majesty lowered ten-thousand-chariot dignity, halted carriage southeast, two palaces about to return, five circuits newly recovered, just ought buy rotten bones, take angry frog as model, to summon heroes, with them jointly govern, how hastily spare these few moments of audience?"
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has lowered the dignity of the imperial throne and halted in the southeast; the two palaces are about to return and the five circuits have just been recovered. This is precisely the time to buy up old bones and take the angry frog as a model, to summon heroes and govern jointly with them—how can you hastily spare these few moments of audience?"

sentences.zh: 書奏，翌日召對便殿，高宗大悅，特旨改合入官，通判洋州。

translations.literal: Memorial submitted, next day summoned for audience in side hall, Gaozong greatly pleased, special decree changed to appropriate rank, vice prefect Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, he was summoned the next day for an audience in the side hall. Gaozong was greatly pleased, and by special decree his rank was changed to the appropriate level and he was appointed vice prefect of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 洋西鄉縣產茶，亙陵谷八百餘里，山窮險，賦不盡括。

translations.literal: Yang Xixiang county produced tea, spanning hills and valleys over eight hundred li, mountains extreme and dangerous, tax not fully collected.
translations.idiomatic: Xixiang county in Yangzhou produced tea across hills and valleys for more than eight hundred li; the mountains were rugged and dangerous, and the tax could not be fully collected.

sentences.zh: 使者韓球將增賦以市寵，園戶避苛斂轉徙，饑饉相藉，文若力爭之，賦迄不增。

translations.literal: Commissioner Han Qiu about to increase tax to buy favor, garden households avoided harsh levies and moved away, famine followed one upon another, Wenruo forcefully contested it, tax finally not increased.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner Han Qiu was about to increase the tax to win favor; tea growers fled harsh levies and migrated, and famine followed upon famine. Wenruo forcefully contested this, and the tax was never increased.

sentences.zh: 再通判遂寧府。

translations.literal: Again vice prefect Suining prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as vice prefect of Suining prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會大水，民多漂死，文若至城上，發庫錢募遊者，振活甚眾。

translations.literal: Coinciding great flood, people many drowned dead, Wenruo went to city wall, issued treasury money to recruit wanderers, relieved and saved very many.
translations.idiomatic: When a great flood struck and many people drowned, Wenruo went up onto the city wall, issued treasury funds to hire laborers, and saved a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 又力請於朝，除田租二萬一千頃，免場務稅二十餘所，築長堤以捍水勢，自是無水患。

translations.literal: Again forcefully requested at court, remitted field rent twenty-one thousand qing, exempted market-office taxes over twenty places, built long dike to resist water force, from then no flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: He also forcefully petitioned the court to remit field rent on twenty-one thousand qing of land, exempt taxes at more than twenty market offices, and build a long dike to hold back the floodwaters; from then on there was no further flood disaster.

sentences.zh: 秦檜死，上訪蜀士于魏良臣，以文若對。

translations.literal: Qin Hui died, emperor inquired Shu scholars of Wei Liangchen, with Wenruo answered.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin Hui died, the emperor asked Wei Liangchen about scholars of Shu, and he named Wenruo.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以光祿丞召，改秘書郎，為《文思箴》以獻，其略曰：「於赫我皇，兵既休矣。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, with Guanglu assistant summoned, changed to Secretariat lang, wrote "Literary Thought Admonition" to present, summary said: "How glorious our emperor, troops already rested.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was summoned as assistant in the Office of Imperial Entertainments and transferred to lang in the Secretariat; he composed the Literary Thought Admonition and presented it, saying in summary, "How glorious is our emperor—the troops have already been rested.

sentences.zh: 兵休如何？

translations.literal: Troops rested how?
translations.idiomatic: How are the troops to be rested?

sentences.zh: 莫若治兵。

translations.literal: None better than govern troops.
translations.idiomatic: There is nothing better than governing the troops.

sentences.zh: 居安思危，邦乃攸寧。

translations.literal: In peace think danger, state then thereby tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: In peace one must think of danger, and then the state will be secure.

sentences.zh: 爰整其旅，文王以興。

translations.literal: Then put in order their hosts, King Wen thereby rose.
translations.idiomatic: When he put his hosts in order, King Wen thereby rose to power.

sentences.zh: 載舞干羽，舜仁用成。

translations.literal: Then danced with shields and feathers, Shun's benevolence thereby accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: When shields and feathers were danced, Shun's benevolent rule was thereby accomplished.

sentences.zh: 向戍弭兵，《春秋》所懲。

translations.literal: Xiang Xu stopped troops, "Spring and Autumn" what it punished.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiang Xu halted the troops, the Spring and Autumn Annals punished this.

sentences.zh: 蕭俯去兵，禍亂乃萌。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiao Fu dismissed troops, disaster and disorder then sprouted.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiao Fu dismissed the troops, disaster and disorder then sprouted.

sentences.zh: 師則多矣，軍則強矣。

translations.literal: Divisions then many, armies then strong.
translations.idiomatic: The divisions are many and the armies are strong.

sentences.zh: 縱弛不繩，猶曰無人。

translations.literal: Loosened and slack without restraint, still say no men.
translations.idiomatic: If they are loosened and left unrestrained, it will still be said that there are no capable men.

sentences.zh: 兵非以殘，以兵休兵。」

translations.literal: Troops not by them destroy, by troops rest troops."
translations.idiomatic: Troops are not for destruction—they are for resting the troops through military readiness."

sentences.zh: 凡千五百餘言。

translations.literal: In all over fifteen hundred words.
translations.idiomatic: In all it ran to more than fifteen hundred words.

sentences.zh: 自檜主和，朝論諱言兵，故文若以此風焉。

translations.literal: Since Hui advocated peace, court discussion tabooed speaking of troops, therefore Wenruo used this to admonish.
translations.idiomatic: Since Hui had advocated peace, court discussion tabooed talk of military affairs, and so Wenruo used this piece to admonish the court.

sentences.zh: 遷起居郎。

translations.literal: Promoted Diarist.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to diarist.

sentences.zh: 勸上收用西北人材以固根本，上深納之。

translations.literal: Advised emperor gather and employ northwest talent to solidify foundation, emperor deeply accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: He urged the emperor to gather and employ talent from the northwest to solidify the foundation, and the emperor deeply accepted this.

sentences.zh: 將命以掌制，時有為宣和執政請恩，為司諫淩哲所彈，文若喜其直，作《禾黍詩》以美之。

translations.literal: About to be ordered to manage drafting, at time someone for Xuanhe chief minister requested favor, impeached by remonstrating official Ling Zhe, Wenruo pleased at his uprightness, composed "Millet and Sorghum Poem" to praise him.
translations.idiomatic: He was about to be appointed to manage imperial drafting when someone requested favors for a Xuanhe-era chief minister and was impeached by the remonstrating official Ling Zhe; Wenruo was pleased at his uprightness and composed the Millet and Sorghum Poem to praise him.

sentences.zh: 侍御史周方崇以為譏己，劾文若狂誕，出知邵州。

translations.literal: Attendant censor Zhou Fangchong thought it mocked himself, impeached Wenruo as mad and reckless, sent out to know Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant censor Zhou Fangchong thought the poem mocked him, impeached Wenruo as mad and reckless, and had him sent out as prefect of Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 上屢為近臣言唐文若無罪，可改近郡。

translations.literal: Emperor repeatedly told close ministers Tang Wenruo without guilt, could change to nearby prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor repeatedly told his close ministers that Tang Wenruo was guiltless and could be transferred to a nearby prefecture.

sentences.zh: 知饒州，興學宮，減田租奇耗二萬石，又請歲糴常平義倉之儲什三與民平市，農末俱利，而粟不腐，遂以著令。

translations.literal: Knew Raozhou, raised school precinct, reduced field rent extraordinary loss twenty thousand shi, again requested yearly purchase from Ever-Normal and Charity Granary stores three-tenths to market-level with people, agriculture and commerce both benefited, yet grain not spoiled, then made established regulation.
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Raozhou he restored the school precinct, reduced extraordinary field-rent losses by twenty thousand shi, and also requested that three-tenths of the yearly stores of the Ever-Normal and Charity Granaries be sold to the people at market price, benefiting both farmers and merchants while keeping grain from spoiling; this was then established as regulation.

sentences.zh: 餘干嘗有劇盜，巡尉不能制，文若遣牙兵捕而戮之。

translations.literal: Yugan once had fierce bandits, patrol officers could not control, Wenruo sent yamen soldiers to capture and execute them.
translations.idiomatic: Yugan once had fierce bandits whom the patrol officers could not control; Wenruo sent yamen soldiers to capture and execute them.

sentences.zh: 加直敷文閣，移知溫州。

translations.literal: Added direct Fuwen Hall, transferred to know Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted direct appointment at the Hall of Diffusing Culture and transferred to serve as prefect of Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，召為宗正少卿。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, summoned as Director of the Imperial Clan vice director.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he was summoned as vice director of the Directorate of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 金人犯邊，文若求對，首建大臣節制江上之議。

translations.literal: Jin people violated border, Wenruo requested audience, first proposed great minister command Yangzi River proposal.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin violated the border, Wenruo requested an audience and was the first to propose that a great minister be appointed to command affairs on the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 上諭大臣以文若與虞允文、杜莘老、馬驥才皆可用，復除起居郎。

translations.literal: Emperor instructed great ministers that Wenruo with Yu Yunwen, Du Shenlao, Ma Jicai all could be used, again removed as Diarist.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the great ministers that Wenruo, Yu Yunwen, Du Shenlao, and Ma Jicai were all usable, and Wenruo was again appointed diarist.

sentences.zh: 時諸將北出，捷書日聞，上下有狃志，獨文若憂之，圖上元嘉北伐故事。

translations.literal: At time various generals northward out, victory reports daily heard, above and below had complacent intent, alone Wenruo worried, submitted chart of Yuanjia northern expedition precedent.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the generals were advancing north and victory reports arrived daily; above and below grew complacent, but Wenruo alone was worried and submitted a chart of the Yuanjia northern expedition as a warning.

sentences.zh: 上諭文若以創業所歷艱苦及敵情反覆甚悉，文若對曰：「願陛下深察大勢，趨策之長而避其短，無循前代軌轍，則大善。」

translations.literal: Emperor instructed Wenruo on founding enterprise hardships endured and enemy situation reversals very fully, Wenruo replied said: "Wish Your Majesty deeply examine great trend, pursue policy's strengths and avoid its weaknesses, not follow previous age tracks, then greatly good."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed Wenruo very fully on the hardships of founding the dynasty and the Jin's repeated reversals. Wenruo replied, "I wish that Your Majesty would deeply examine the overall situation, pursue what is strong in our policy and avoid what is weak, and not follow the tracks of previous ages—then all would be well."

sentences.zh: 未幾，諸軍退守，金主自將，圍大將王權于歷陽，權遁，淮南盡沒。

translations.literal: Not long after, various armies retreated to defend, Jin ruler personally led troops, surrounded great general Wang Quan at Liyang, Quan fled, Huainan completely lost.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the armies fell back to the defensive; the Jin ruler personally led his troops and surrounded the great general Wang Quan at Liyang. Quan fled and all of Huainan was lost.

sentences.zh: 詔百官廷議，文若畫三策，一請上親征，二乞遣大臣勞軍，三乞起張浚。

translations.literal: Edict hundred officials court deliberation, Wenruo drew three plans, one request emperor personally campaign, two beg send great minister comfort troops, three beg recall Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the hundred officials to deliberate at court. Wenruo outlined three plans: first, that the emperor personally take the field; second, that a great minister be sent to comfort the troops; third, that Zhang Jun be recalled.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎許尹是其言，眾遂列奏上之，不報。

translations.literal: Ministry of Works vice minister Xu Yin agreed with his words, crowd then listed memorial submitted it, no response.
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister of Works Xu Yin agreed with his proposal, and the officials jointly submitted a memorial, but there was no response.

sentences.zh: 文若尋面對，上問曰：「今計安出，卿熟張浚否？」

translations.literal: Wenruo soon face-to-face audience, emperor asked said: "Now plan from where emerge, do you know Zhang Jun well?"
translations.idiomatic: Wenruo soon had a face-to-face audience. The emperor asked, "What plan should we adopt now? Do you know Zhang Jun well?"

sentences.zh: 文若曰：「浚守道篤學，天下屬望，今四十年，天不死浚嶺海，正為今日。」

translations.literal: Wenruo said: "Jun guards the Way and deeply studies, all under Heaven looks to him, now forty years, Heaven did not kill Jun in mountain sea, precisely for this day."
translations.idiomatic: Wenruo said, "Jun upholds the Way and is deeply learned; all under Heaven looks to him. For forty years Heaven has not let him die in exile precisely for this day."

sentences.zh: 上矍然曰：「援浚者多，非卿無以發此。」

translations.literal: Emperor startled said: "Those supporting Jun are many, without you none could raise this."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor started and said, "Many support Jun, but without you none could have raised this."

sentences.zh: 數日，遣楊存中護江上軍，緩親征之期，起浚知平江府，蓋上以浚雖忠愨，喜功，將士多不附。

translations.literal: Several days later, sent Yang Cunzhong to guard Yangzi River armies, delayed personal campaign date, recalled Jun to know Pingjiang prefecture, probably emperor because Jun though loyal and sincere, loved merit, officers and soldiers many not attached.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Yang Cunzhong was sent to guard the armies on the Yangzi and the date of the emperor's personal campaign was postponed; Jun was recalled to serve as prefect of Pingjiang—probably because the emperor felt that though Jun was loyal and sincere, he loved glory and many officers and soldiers did not follow him.

sentences.zh: 文若復言浚本以孤忠得眾，尋改浚鎮建康府，將以為江淮宣撫使，中沮之而止。

translations.literal: Wenruo again said Jun originally by solitary loyalty gained followers, soon changed Jun to garrison Jiankang prefecture, about to make him Huai-Jiang pacification commissioner, midway obstructed and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wenruo again argued that Jun had originally won followers through solitary loyalty; soon Jun was transferred to command Jiankang prefecture and was about to be made pacification commissioner of the Huai and Yangzi region, but the plan was obstructed midway and stopped.

sentences.zh: 乘輿幸江表，以起居郎兼給事中，直學士院，同群司居守。

translations.literal: Imperial carriage visited Jiang region, with Diarist concurrently Supervising Secretary, direct Academy of Scholarly Worthies, together with various offices remained to guard.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage visited the Jiang region, he served as diarist and concurrently supervising secretary, was on duty at the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and remained with the other offices to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 駕還，遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: Carriage returned, promoted Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage returned he was promoted to drafter of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 上將內禪，前數日手詔追崇皇太子所生父，文若既書黃，因過周必大誦聖德，而疑名稱未安，歸白宰相，請更黃，堂吏不可，文若執不已，宰相以聞。

translations.literal: Emperor about to abdicate internally, several days before hand edict posthumously honored Crown Prince's biological father, Wenruo already wrote yellow draft, then visited Zhou Bida recited imperial virtue, yet doubted title not settled, returned told chief minister, requested change yellow draft, hall clerks not permit, Wenruo persisted without stop, chief minister reported it.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was about to abdicate, several days beforehand a hand edict posthumously honored the crown prince's biological father. After Wenruo had drafted the edict in yellow, he visited Zhou Bida and recited the emperor's virtue, yet doubted that the title was not settled; he returned and told the chief minister, requesting a revised draft. The hall clerks refused, but Wenruo persisted until the chief minister reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 詔改稱本生親，尋又改宗室子偁，其後詔稱皇兄。

translations.literal: Edict changed title to biological parent, soon again changed to imperial clan child called, afterward edict called imperial elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed the title to biological parent; soon it was changed again to calling him a child of the imperial clan; afterward an edict called him imperial elder brother.

sentences.zh: 孝宗嗣位，張浚以右府都督江、淮軍事，文若時以疾請外，除敷文閣待制，知漢州，尋改都督府參贊軍事。

translations.literal: Xiaozong succeeded throne, Zhang Jun with Right Office commanded Jiang and Huai military affairs, Wenruo at time because illness requested outside post, removed as Fuwen Hall attendant draft, know Hanzhou, soon changed to Commandery staff military adviser.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong succeeded to the throne, Zhang Jun as head of the Right Office commanded military affairs on the Jiang and Huai fronts. Wenruo at the time requested an outside post on account of illness, was appointed attendant draft at the Hall of Diffusing Culture and prefect of Hanzhou, and was soon changed to military adviser on the commandery staff.

sentences.zh: 浚使行邊按守備，多所罷行者。

translations.literal: Jun sent him to tour border inspect defenses, many dismissed and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Jun sent him to tour the border and inspect defenses, and many officials were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 未還，除知鼎州，改江州。

translations.literal: Not yet returned, removed as know Dingzhou, changed to Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before he returned he was appointed prefect of Dingzhou, then transferred to Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，浚入相，都督府罷。

translations.literal: Next year, Jun entered as chief minister, Commandery abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Jun entered the government as chief minister and the commandery was abolished.

sentences.zh: 其冬，金復大入，官軍悉戍淮。

translations.literal: That winter, Jin again greatly invaded, official armies all garrisoned Huai.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Jin invaded again on a large scale and the official armies were all stationed on the Huai front.

sentences.zh: 文若謂上流當嚴兵備，以定民志，奏籍鄉丁五萬，訓練有法，人倚以固。

translations.literal: Wenruo said upper reaches ought strictly prepare troops, to settle people's will, memorialized registering village militia fifty thousand, training had method, people relied on this to stabilize.
translations.idiomatic: Wenruo said the upper reaches ought to be strictly defended to steady the people's resolve; he memorialized to register fifty thousand village militia, trained them by proper methods, and the people relied on this for security.

sentences.zh: 解嚴，和糴大起，郡之數八萬，文若以民勞，堅請得減什三。

translations.literal: Alert lifted, harmonized purchase greatly arose, prefecture's quota eighty thousand, Wenruo because people weary, firmly requested obtained reduction three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: When the alert was lifted a large harmonized-purchase levy was imposed with a prefectural quota of eighty thousand; Wenruo, citing the people's exhaustion, firmly petitioned and obtained a reduction of three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 旋請祠，章三上未報。

translations.literal: Soon requested temple post, memorials three submitted no response.
translations.idiomatic: He soon requested a temple post; three memorials were submitted without response.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年卒，年六十。

translations.literal: Qiandao first year died, age sixty.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of the Qiandao reign, at the age of sixty.

sentences.zh: 贈左通奉大夫。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Left Tongfeng Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of Left Grand Master for Meritorious Service.

sentences.zh: 李燾，字仁甫，眉州丹棱人，唐宗室曹王之後也。

translations.literal: Li Tao, courtesy name Renfu, Meizhou Danling person, Tang imperial clan Prince of Cao descendant.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tao, courtesy name Renfu, was a native of Danling in Meizhou and a descendant of the Tang imperial clan's Prince of Cao.

sentences.zh: 父中登第，知仙井監。

translations.literal: Father Zhong passed rank, knew Xianjing supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhong passed the examinations and served as supervisor of Xianjing.

sentences.zh: 燾甫冠，憤金仇未報，著《反正議》十四篇，皆救時大務。

translations.literal: Tao just capped, angry Jin enmity not avenged, wrote "Rectification Discussions" fourteen chapters, all urgent age great tasks.
translations.idiomatic: When Tao had just come of age, angry that the Jin enmity had not been avenged, he wrote fourteen chapters of Rectification Discussions, all on the great tasks of saving the age.

sentences.zh: 紹興八年，擢進士第。

translations.literal: Shaoxing eighth year, selected jinshi rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of the Shaoxing reign he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 調華陽簿，再調雅州推官。

translations.literal: Assigned Huayang registrar, again assigned Yazhou investigating officer.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned as registrar of Huayang and then as investigating officer of Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 改秩，知雙流縣。

translations.literal: Changed rank, knew Shuangliu county.
translations.idiomatic: His rank was changed and he became magistrate of Shuangliu county.

sentences.zh: 仕族張氏子居喪而爭產，燾曰：「若忍墜先訓乎？

translations.literal: Official family Zhang clan son in mourning yet disputing property, Tao said: "Can you bear to fall from ancestral instruction?
translations.idiomatic: A son of the official Zhang clan was in mourning yet disputing an inheritance. Tao said, "Can you bear to fall away from your ancestors' instruction?

sentences.zh: 盍歸思之。」

translations.literal: Why not return and think on it."
translations.idiomatic: Why not go home and reflect on it?"

sentences.zh: 三日復來，迄悔艾無訟。

translations.literal: Three days later again came, finally repented and no lawsuit.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later he returned, and in the end repented and dropped the lawsuit.

sentences.zh: 又有不白其母而鬻產者，燾置之理，豪強斂跡。

translations.literal: Also was one who without informing mother sold property, Tao placed in judgment, powerful families restrained footsteps.
translations.idiomatic: There was also someone who sold property without informing his mother; Tao placed the case in judgment and the powerful families restrained themselves.

sentences.zh: 於是以餘暇力學。

translations.literal: Thereupon with spare time vigorously studied.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, in his spare time, he studied vigorously.

sentences.zh: 燾恥讀王氏書，獨博極載籍，搜羅百氏，慨然以史自任，本朝典故尤悉力研核。

translations.literal: Tao ashamed to read Wang clan books, alone broadly reached records and archives, searched and gathered hundred schools, sighed to take history as own task, this dynasty's regulations especially fully exerted to research and verify.
translations.idiomatic: Tao was ashamed to read the books of the Wang clan; he alone ranged broadly through records and archives, gathered the hundred schools, and resolved to take history as his own task, especially exerting himself to research and verify the regulations of the present dynasty.

sentences.zh: 仿司馬光《資治通鑒》例，斷自建隆，迄于靖康，為編年一書，名曰《長編》，浩大未畢，仍效光體為《百官公卿表》。

translations.literal: Imitated Sima Guang "Comprehensive Mirror" example, from Jianlong cut off, until Jingkang, made annalistic one book, named "Extended Compilation," vast not completed, still imitated Guang's form made "Officials and Ministers Table."
translations.idiomatic: Following the example of Sima Guang's Comprehensive Mirror, he compiled an annalistic work from the Jianlong reign through the Jingkang era, naming it the Extended Compilation; though vast and unfinished, he also imitated Guang's form in compiling the Table of Officials and Ministers.

sentences.zh: 史官以聞，詔給劄來上。

translations.literal: Historiographers reported it, edict granted document come submit.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographers reported this and an edict granted him a document ordering him to submit the work.

sentences.zh: 制置王剛中辟幹辦公事。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Wang Gangzhong recruited staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commissioner Wang Gangzhong recruited him as a staff officer.

sentences.zh: 知榮州。

translations.literal: Knew Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 榮因溪為隍，夏秋率苦水潦，燾築防捍之。

translations.literal: Rong relied on streams as moat, summer autumn mostly suffered floods, Tao built defenses to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Rong relied on streams as its moat and each summer and autumn mostly suffered floods; Tao built defenses to hold them back.

sentences.zh: 除潼川府路轉運判官，入境，劾守令不職者四人。

translations.literal: Removed as Tongchuan circuit transport commissioner, entering territory, impeached prefects and magistrates not performing duties four men.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed transport commissioner of the Tongchuan circuit; upon entering the territory he impeached four prefects and magistrates for dereliction of duty.

sentences.zh: 縣多聚斂，燾括一路財賦額，通有無，酌三年中數，定為科約，上之朝，頒之州縣。

translations.literal: Counties many gathered levies, Tao compiled one circuit fiscal revenue quota, connected surplus and deficit, weighed three-year middle number, fixed as tax covenant, submitted to court, promulgated to prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: The counties mostly gathered excessive levies; Tao compiled the circuit's fiscal quotas, balanced surplus and deficit, weighed the median over three years, and fixed a tax covenant, which he submitted to the court and had promulgated to prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 乾道三年，召對，首舉藝祖治身、治家、治官、治吏典故，以為恢復之法，乞增置諫官，許六察言事，請練兵，毋增兵，杜諸將私獻，覈軍中虛籍。

translations.literal: Qiandao third year, summoned for audience, first cited Taizu's governing self, governing family, governing officials, governing clerks precedents, as recovery method, begged add remonstrating officials, permit six investigations speak affairs, requested drill troops, not increase troops, stop various generals private gifts, verify army false registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Qiandao reign he was summoned for an audience and first cited precedents from Taizu's governing of himself, his family, officials, and clerks as a method of recovery; he requested additional remonstrating officials, permission for the six investigations to speak on affairs, drilling of troops rather than increasing troop numbers, stopping private gifts from generals, and verification of false rolls in the army.

sentences.zh: 除兵部員外郎兼禮部郎中。

translations.literal: Removed as Ministry of War vice director concurrently Ministry of Rites lang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director in the Ministry of War and concurrently lang in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 會慶節上壽，在郊禮散齋內，議權作樂，燾言：「漢、唐祀天地，散齋四日，致齋三日，建隆初郊亦然。

translations.literal: Coinciding celebration festival birthday offering, within suburban rite dispersal fast, deliberated provisional make music, Tao said: "Han, Tang sacrificed Heaven and Earth, dispersal fast four days, concentration fast three days, Jianlong first suburban sacrifice also thus.
translations.idiomatic: When the celebration festival birthday offering fell within the dispersal fast of the suburban rites, there was deliberation over provisionally allowing music. Tao said, "In Han and Tang sacrifices to Heaven and Earth there were four days of dispersal fast and three days of concentration fast; the first suburban sacrifice of the Jianlong reign was the same.

sentences.zh: 自崇寧、大觀法《周禮》祭天地，故前十日受誓戒。

translations.literal: Since Chongning, Daguan followed "Rites of Zhou" sacrifice Heaven and Earth, therefore ten days before received oath and abstinence.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Chongning and Daguan reigns followed the Rites of Zhou for sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, the oath and abstinence were received ten days beforehand.

sentences.zh: 今既合祭，宜復漢、唐及建隆舊制，庶幾兩得。」

translations.literal: Now already combined sacrifice, ought restore Han, Tang and Jianlong old system, perhaps both obtained."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the sacrifices are combined, we ought to restore the old systems of Han, Tang, and the Jianlong reign, so that both aims may be achieved."

sentences.zh: 詔垂拱上壽止樂，正殿為北使權用。

translations.literal: Edict at Chui Gong birthday offering stop music, main hall for northern envoys provisional use.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that music cease at the Chui Gong birthday offering and that the main hall be used provisionally for the northern envoys.

sentences.zh: 正除禮部郎中，言中興祭禮未備，請以《開寶通禮》、《嘉祐因革禮》、《政和新儀》令太常寺參校同異，修成祭法。

translations.literal: Formally removed as Ministry of Rites lang, said Restoration sacrifice rites not complete, requested with "Kaibao Comprehensive Rites," "Jiayou Reformed Rites," "Zhenghe New Rituals" order Directorate of Ceremonial compare similarities and differences, compile sacrifice law.
translations.idiomatic: He was formally appointed lang in the Ministry of Rites and said that the Restoration sacrifice rites were not complete; he requested that the Kaibao Comprehensive Rites, the Jiayou Reformed Rites, and the Zhenghe New Rituals be used to order the Directorate of Ceremonial to compare similarities and differences and compile a sacrifice code.

sentences.zh: 四年，上《續通鑒長編》，自建隆至治平，凡一百八卷。

translations.literal: Fourth year, submitted "Continuation Comprehensive Mirror Extended Compilation," from Jianlong to Zhiping, in all one hundred eight juan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he submitted the Continuation Comprehensive Mirror Extended Compilation, from the Jianlong reign through the Zhiping reign, in all one hundred eight juan.

sentences.zh: 時《乾道新曆》成，燾言：「曆不差不改，不驗不用。

translations.literal: At time "Qiandao New Calendar" completed, Tao said: "Calendar without error not change, without verification not use.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qiandao New Calendar was completed, Tao said, "A calendar that is without error need not be changed; one that is without verification should not be used.

sentences.zh: 未差無以知其失，未驗無以知其是。

translations.literal: Without error cannot know its failure, without verification cannot know its correctness.
translations.idiomatic: Without error one cannot know its faults; without verification one cannot know its correctness.

sentences.zh: 舊曆多差，不容不改，而新曆亦未有大驗，乞申飭曆官討論。」

translations.literal: Old calendar many errors, cannot not change, yet new calendar also not yet had great verification, beg order calendar officials discuss."
translations.idiomatic: The old calendar had many errors and could not but be changed, yet the new calendar also had not yet been greatly verified; he begged that the calendar officials be ordered to discuss the matter."

sentences.zh: 五年，遷秘書少監兼權起居舍人，尋兼實錄院檢討官。

translations.literal: Fifth year, promoted Secretariat vice director concurrently acting Diarist, soon concurrently Veritable Records Academy reviser.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to vice director of the Secretariat and concurrently acting diarist, and soon also reviser at the Academy of Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 子垕試賢良方正直言極諫科。

translations.literal: Son Hou tested Worthy and Good, Upright and Direct, Outspoken and Remonstrating category.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hou tested in the category of worthy and good, upright and direct, outspoken and remonstrating.

sentences.zh: 燾素謂唐三百年不愧此科者惟劉去華，心慕之，嘗以所著《通論》五十篇見蜀帥張燾，欲應詔，不偶而止。

translations.literal: Tao always said Tang three hundred years not ashamed of this category only Liu Quhua, heart admired him, once with written "General Discussions" fifty chapters saw Shu commander Zhang Tao, wished respond to edict, not matched and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Tao had always said that in three hundred years of Tang only Liu Quhua was worthy of this category without shame; he admired him in his heart and once showed his fifty chapters of General Discussions to the Shu commander Zhang Tao, wishing to respond to the edict, but stopped when the opportunity did not come.

sentences.zh: 其友晁公溯以書勉之，燾答以當修此學，必不從此舉。

translations.literal: His friend Chao Gongsu with letter encouraged him, Tao replied that ought cultivate this learning, certainly not follow this examination.
translations.idiomatic: His friend Chao Gongsu encouraged him by letter, and Tao replied that he ought to cultivate this learning and would certainly not take this examination.

sentences.zh: 既不克躬試，於是命二子垕、塾習焉。

translations.literal: Since not able personally test, thereupon ordered two sons Hou, Shu to study it.
translations.idiomatic: Since he could not take the examination himself, he then ordered his two sons Hou and Shu to study for it.

sentences.zh: 至是，吏部尚書汪應辰薦垕文行可應詔，故有是命。

translations.literal: At this, Ministry of Personnel minister Wang Yingchen recommended Hou literary conduct could respond to edict, therefore had this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the minister of personnel Wang Yingchen recommended Hou as having literary conduct worthy of responding to the edict, and therefore this appointment was made.

sentences.zh: 左相陳俊卿出知福州，右相虞允文任恢復事，更張舊典。

translations.literal: Left chief minister Chen Junqing sent out to know Fuzhou, right chief minister Yu Yunwen undertook recovery affairs, changed and spread old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The left chief minister Chen Junqing was sent out as prefect of Fuzhou, the right chief minister Yu Yunwen undertook affairs of recovery, and old regulations were changed and expanded.

sentences.zh: 宰相以燾數言事，不樂，燾遂請去。

translations.literal: Chief ministers because Tao repeatedly spoke on affairs, not pleased, Tao then requested leave.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers were displeased because Tao repeatedly spoke on affairs, and Tao then requested to leave office.

sentences.zh: 除直顯謨閣、湖北轉運副使，陛辭，以欲速變古為戒。

translations.literal: Removed as direct Xianmo Hall, Hubei transport vice commissioner, audience farewell, took haste and changing antiquity as warning.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed direct attendant at the Hall of Manifest Counsel and vice transport commissioner of Hubei; at his farewell audience he warned against haste and changing antiquity.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「《禹貢》九州，荊田第八，賦乃在三，人功既修，遂超五等。

translations.literal: Again memorialized: "'Tribute of Yu' nine provinces, Jing fields eighth rank, tax yet in third, human labor already cultivated, then surpassed five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized: "In the Tribute of Yu among the nine provinces, Jing ranked eighth in fields yet third in tax; once human labor had been applied, it surpassed five ranks.

sentences.zh: 今田多荒蕪，賦虧十八。」

translations.literal: Now fields many overgrown, tax short eighteen."
translations.idiomatic: Now the fields are largely overgrown and tax revenue falls short by eighteen parts."

sentences.zh: 上命之條畫。

translations.literal: Emperor ordered him itemize plans.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him to itemize plans.

sentences.zh: 既至，奏：「京湖之民結茅而廬，築土而坊，傭牛而犁，糴種而殖，穀苗未立，睥睨已多，有橫加科斂者。

translations.literal: Already arrived, memorialized: "Jing-Hu people thatch huts for dwellings, build earth for embankments, hire oxen to plow, buy seed to plant, grain shoots not yet established, covetous eyes already many, some forcibly add levies.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived he memorialized: "The people of Jing and Hu thatch huts for dwellings, build earth embankments, hire oxen to plow, and buy seed to plant; before the grain shoots are established, covetous eyes are already many, and some forcibly add levies.

sentences.zh: 今宜寬侵冒之禁，依乾德詔書止輸舊稅，廣收募之術，如咸平、元豐故事，勸課有勞者推恩。」

translations.literal: Now ought relax encroachment prohibitions, follow Qiande edict only pay old tax, broaden recruitment methods, like Xianping, Yuanfeng precedents, encourage farming with merit grant favor."
translations.idiomatic: Now we ought to relax prohibitions on encroachment, follow the Qiande edict in paying only the old tax, broaden recruitment methods as in the Xianping and Yuanfeng precedents, and grant favor to those who labor in encouraging farming."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: Edict followed it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that this be followed.

sentences.zh: 總餉呂遊問入奏燾攝其事。

translations.literal: General supplies Lü Youwen entered court memorialized Tao handled its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The general supplies commissioner Lü Youwen entered court and reported that Tao had handled the matter.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，發鄂州大軍倉振之，僚屬爭執不可，燾曰：「吾自任，不以累諸君。」

translations.literal: Year famine, issued Ezhou great army granary to relieve it, staff members disputed could not, Tao said: "I myself bear responsibility, not to involve you gentlemen."
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine he issued grain from the great army granary at Ezhou for relief; his staff disputed that this could not be done. Tao said, "I myself bear responsibility and will not involve you gentlemen."

sentences.zh: 尋如數償之。

translations.literal: Soon according to amount repaid it.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he repaid it in full.

sentences.zh: 遊問返，果劾燾專，上止令具析，不之罪也。

translations.literal: Youwen returned, indeed impeached Tao as arbitrary, emperor only ordered detailed explanation, not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: When Youwen returned he did impeach Tao for acting arbitrarily, but the emperor only ordered a detailed explanation and did not punish him.

sentences.zh: 八年，直寶文閣，帥潼川兼知瀘州，首葺石門堡以扼夷人，奏乞戒茶馬司市敘州羈縻馬毋溢額，戒官民毋於夷、漢禁山伐木造舟，奏移鎖水于開邊舊池，皆報可。

translations.literal: Eighth year, direct Baowen Hall, commanded Tongchuan concurrently knew Luzhou, first repaired Shimen fort to choke Yi people, memorialized beg warn Tea-Horse Office purchase Xuzhou tributary horses not exceed quota, warn officials and people not in Yi and Han forbidden mountains cut wood build boats, memorialized move Suo River to Kaibian old pool, all reported approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was granted direct appointment at the Hall of Precious Culture, commanded Tongchuan while concurrently serving as prefect of Luzhou, first repaired Shimen fort to choke off the Yi, memorialized to warn the Tea-Horse Office not to exceed the quota in purchasing tributary horses from Xuzhou, warned officials and people not to cut timber and build boats in the forbidden mountains of the Yi and Han regions, and memorialized to move the Suo River to the old pool at Kaibian—all were approved.

sentences.zh: 淳熙改元，被召，適城中火，上章自劾。

translations.literal: Chunxi changed reign title, summoned, coincidentally city fire, submitted memorial self-impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chunxi reign title was changed he was summoned, but a fire broke out in the city and he submitted a memorial impeaching himself.

sentences.zh: 提刑何熙志奏焚數不實，且言《長編》記魏王食肥彘，語涉誣謗，上曰：「憲臣按奏火數失實，職也，何預國史？」

translations.literal: Intendant He Xizhi memorialized fire count not true, and said "Extended Compilation" records Prince of Wei ate fat pig, words involve slander, emperor said: "Censor investigating and reporting fire count false, duty, what relation to national history?"
translations.idiomatic: The intendant He Xizhi memorialized that the fire count was false and said that the Extended Compilation records the Prince of Wei eating a fat pig, language involving slander. The emperor said, "For a censor to investigate and report a false fire count is his duty—what has that to do with national history?"

sentences.zh: 命成都提刑李蘩究火事，詔熙志貶二秩罷，燾止貶一秩。

translations.literal: Ordered Chengdu intendant Li Fan investigate fire affair, edict Xizhi demoted two ranks dismissed, Tao only demoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Chengdu intendant Li Fan to investigate the fire affair, issued an edict that Xizhi be demoted two ranks and dismissed, and Tao was demoted only one rank.

sentences.zh: 燾及都門，乞祠，除江西運副，且許臨遣。

translations.literal: Tao reached capital gate, begged temple post, removed as Jiangxi transport vice commissioner, and permitted farewell audience.
translations.idiomatic: When Tao reached the capital gate he requested a temple post, was appointed vice transport commissioner of Jiangxi, and was granted a farewell audience.

sentences.zh: 或勸以方被讒，無及時事，燾曰：「聖主全度如此，竭忠所以為報。」

translations.literal: Some advised that just slandered, not touch current affairs, Tao said: "Sagely lord's full magnanimity thus, exhaust loyalty therefore as repayment."
translations.idiomatic: Some advised that since he had just been slandered he should not touch current affairs. Tao said, "The sagely lord's full magnanimity is such that exhausting loyalty is how one repays him."

sentences.zh: 遂奏：「日食、地震皆陰盛，主敵國小人，不可不慮。」

translations.literal: Thereupon memorialized: "Solar eclipse, earthquake all yin flourishing, presage enemy state petty men, cannot not consider."
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he memorialized: "Solar eclipses and earthquakes all indicate yin flourishing and presage enemy states and petty men—we cannot fail to consider this."

sentences.zh: 且申「無變古、無欲速」兩言，又上《快箴》，引太祖罷朝悔乘快決事以諫，上曰：「朕當揭之座右。」

translations.literal: And reiterated "no changing antiquity, no haste" two sayings, again submitted "Haste Admonition," cited Taizu after court regretted riding fast deciding affairs to remonstrate, emperor said: "I ought post it at seat's right."
translations.idiomatic: He also reiterated the two sayings "do not change antiquity" and "do not be hasty," and submitted the Haste Admonition, citing how Taizu after court regretted riding fast to decide affairs; the emperor said, "I shall post this at my right hand."

sentences.zh: 進秘閣修撰、權同修國史、權實錄院同修撰。

translations.literal: Advanced Secretariat compiler, acting concurrent compiler of National History, acting Veritable Records Academy concurrent compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to compiler at the Secretariat, acting concurrent compiler of the National History, and acting concurrent compiler at the Academy of Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 燾為左史時，嘗乞復行明堂禮，謂「南郊、明堂初無隆殺，合視圜壇，特免出郊浮費。」

translations.literal: Tao as Left Historian time, once begged restore Bright Hall rites, said "Southern Suburb, Bright Hall originally no elevation and reduction, ought view round altar together, specially exempt going to suburb wasteful expense."
translations.idiomatic: When Tao was Left Historian he once requested restoration of Bright Hall rites, saying, "The Southern Suburb and Bright Hall originally had no elevation or reduction in rank; they ought to be viewed together with the round altar, specially exempting the wasteful expense of going to the suburb."

sentences.zh: 至是申言之，詔集議，嬖幸沮止。

translations.literal: At this reiterated it, edict gathered deliberation, favorites obstructed and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he reiterated the proposal; an edict ordered deliberation, but favorites obstructed and stopped it.

sentences.zh: 其後周必大為禮部尚書，申其說，始克行。

translations.literal: Afterward Zhou Bida as Ministry of Rites minister, reiterated his proposal, then able to carry out.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, when Zhou Bida became minister of rites, he reiterated the proposal and it was finally carried out.

sentences.zh: 權禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Acting Ministry of Rites vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 七月壬戌，雷震太祖廟柱，壞鴟尾，有司旋加修繕。

translations.literal: Seventh month renchen day, thunder struck Taizu temple pillar, damaged owl-tail ornament, relevant offices soon added repairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the seventh month thunder struck a pillar of Taizu's temple and damaged the owl-tail ornament; the relevant offices soon added repairs.

sentences.zh: 燾奏非所以畏天變，當應以實。

translations.literal: Tao memorialized not the way to fear heaven's changes, ought respond with substance.
translations.idiomatic: Tao memorialized that this was not the way to fear heaven's changes and that the response ought to be substantive.

sentences.zh: 上諭大臣：「燾愛朕，屢進讜言。」

translations.literal: Emperor instructed great ministers: "Tao loves Us, repeatedly advances loyal words."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the great ministers, "Tao loves Us and repeatedly advances loyal words."

sentences.zh: 賜金紫。

translations.literal: Granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted gold and purple insignia.

sentences.zh: 嘗請正太祖東向之位。

translations.literal: Once requested correct Taizu's east-facing position.
translations.idiomatic: He once requested correction of Taizu's east-facing position.

sentences.zh: 四年，駕幸太學，以執經特轉一官。

translations.literal: Fourth year, carriage visited Imperial Academy, because holding classics specially advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Academy, he was specially advanced one rank for holding the classics.

sentences.zh: 燾論兩學釋奠：從祀孔子，當升范仲淹、歐陽修、司馬光、蘇軾，黜王安石父子；

translations.literal: Tao discussed two academies libation sacrifice: accompanying sacrifice to Confucius, ought promote Fan Zhongyan, Ouyang Xiu, Sima Guang, Su Shi, dismiss Wang Anshi father and son;
translations.idiomatic: Tao discussed the libation sacrifices at the two academies: in accompanying sacrifice to Confucius, Fan Zhongyan, Ouyang Xiu, Sima Guang, and Su Shi ought to be promoted and Wang Anshi and his son dismissed;

sentences.zh: 從祀武成王，當黜李勣。

translations.literal: Accompanying sacrifice to Martial Accomplishment King, ought dismiss Li Ji.
translations.idiomatic: in accompanying sacrifice to the Martial Accomplishment King, Li Ji ought to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 眾議不叶，止黜王雱而已。

translations.literal: General discussion not agree, only dismissed Wang Pang.
translations.idiomatic: General discussion did not agree, and only Wang Pang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 真拜侍郎，仍兼工部。

translations.literal: Formally appointed vice minister, still concurrently Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was formally appointed vice minister while still concurrently serving in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 《徽宗實錄》置院已久，趣上奏篇，燾薦呂祖謙學識之明，召為秘書郎兼檢討官。

translations.literal: "Huizong Veritable Records" academy established long, urged submit chapters, Tao recommended Lü Zuqian learning and knowledge bright, summoned as Secretariat lang concurrently reviser.
translations.idiomatic: The academy for the Huizong Veritable Records had been established for a long time and was urged to submit chapters; Tao recommended Lü Zuqian for his bright learning and knowledge, and he was summoned as lang in the Secretariat and concurrently reviser.

sentences.zh: 夜直宣引，奏：「近者蒙氣蔽日，厥占不肖者祿，股肱耳目宜謹厥與。」

translations.literal: Night duty at Xuan Hall audience, memorialized: "Recently haze covered sun, its omen unworthy ones receive salary, arms and legs eyes and ears ought carefully their associations."
translations.idiomatic: On night duty at the Xuan Hall audience he memorialized: "Recently haze has covered the sun; its omen is that unworthy men receive salary—the emperor's arms, legs, eyes, and ears ought carefully to consider their associations."

sentences.zh: 賜坐。

translations.literal: Granted seat.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted a seat.

sentences.zh: 欲起，又留賜飲、賜茶。

translations.literal: Wished to rise, again detained granted drink, granted tea.
translations.idiomatic: When he wished to rise he was detained again and granted drink and tea.

sentences.zh: 尋詔監視太史測驗天文。

translations.literal: Soon edict supervised Grand Astrologer test and verify astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered him to supervise the grand astrologer in testing and verifying astronomy.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，日當夜食，燾為社壇祭告官，伐鼓禮廢，特舉行。

translations.literal: Ninth month dingyou day, sun ought night eclipse, Tao as altar sacrifice announcing officer, drum-beating rite abolished, specially carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the ninth month, when a lunar eclipse was expected, Tao as the altar sacrifice announcing officer specially carried out the drum-beating rite though it had been abolished.

sentences.zh: 垕既中制科，為秘書省正字，尋遷著作郎兼國史實錄院編修檢討官。

translations.literal: Hou already passed decree examination category, was Secretariat corrector, soon promoted Compiler concurrently National History Veritable Records Academy compiler reviser.
translations.idiomatic: After Hou passed the decree examination category he became corrector in the Secretariat and was soon promoted to compiler, concurrently compiler and reviser at the National History and Veritable Records Academy.

sentences.zh: 父子同主史事，搢紳榮之。

translations.literal: Father and son together managed history affairs, gentry honored it.
translations.idiomatic: Father and son together managed historical affairs, and the gentry honored this.

sentences.zh: 燾感上知遇，論事益切，每集議，眾莫敢發言，獨條陳可否無所避。

translations.literal: Tao moved by emperor's recognition, discussed affairs more earnest, each gathered deliberation, crowd none dared speak, alone itemized feasible and not feasible without avoidance.
translations.idiomatic: Moved by the emperor's recognition, Tao spoke on affairs ever more earnestly; at each gathered deliberation none dared speak, but he alone itemized what was feasible and what was not without avoidance.

sentences.zh: 近臣復舉其次子塾應制科，以閣試不中程黜。

translations.literal: Close ministers again recommended second son Shu respond to decree category, because academy test not meet standard dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Close ministers again recommended his second son Shu for the decree examination category, but he was dismissed because he did not meet the standard in the academy test.

sentences.zh: 垕偶考上舍試卷，發策問制科，為御史所劾，語連及燾，垕罷，燾亦知常德府。

translations.literal: Hou accidentally examined upper-house test papers, issued policy question on decree category, impeached by censor, words connected to Tao, Hou dismissed, Tao also knew Changde prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hou accidentally examined upper-house test papers and issued a policy question on the decree category; he was impeached by a censor and the matter connected to Tao. Hou was dismissed and Tao was also sent out as prefect of Changde.

sentences.zh: 初，政和末，澧、辰、沅、靖四州置營田刀弩手，募人開邊，范世雄等附會擾民，建炎罷之。

translations.literal: Initially, Zhenghe end, Li, Chen, Yuan, Jing four prefectures established garrison-field crossbowmen, recruited people open frontier, Fan Shixiong and others attached and disturbed people, Jianyan abolished it.
