translations.idiomatic: Initially, at the end of the Zhenghe reign, the four prefectures of Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing established garrison-field crossbowmen to recruit people to open the frontier; Fan Shixiong and others attached themselves to the policy and disturbed the people, and it was abolished in the Jianyan era.

sentences.zh: 乾道間，有建請復置者，燾為轉運使，嘗奏不當復，已而提刑尹機迫郡縣行之，田不能給。

translations.literal: Qiandao period, some proposed restore it, Tao as transport commissioner, once memorialized ought not restore, afterward intendant Yin Ji forced prefectures and counties carry out, fields could not supply.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qiandao period some proposed restoring it; Tao as transport commissioner once memorialized that it ought not be restored, but afterward the intendant Yin Ji forced prefectures and counties to carry it out and the fields could not supply it.

sentences.zh: 燾至是又申言之，請度田立額，且約帥臣張栻列奏，詔從之。

translations.literal: Tao at this again reiterated it, requested survey fields establish quota, and arranged commander Zhang Shi jointly memorialize, edict followed.
translations.idiomatic: Tao at this point reiterated the matter, requested surveying fields and establishing quotas, and arranged with the commander Zhang Shi to submit a joint memorial; an edict followed this.

sentences.zh: 境多茶園，異時禁切商賈，率至交兵，燾曰：「官捕茶賊，豈禁茶商？」

translations.literal: Territory many tea gardens, in past strictly prohibited merchants, mostly led to armed conflict, Tao said: "Officials capture tea bandits, how forbid tea merchants?"
translations.idiomatic: The territory had many tea gardens; in the past merchants were strictly prohibited and this mostly led to armed conflict. Tao said, "Officials capture tea bandits—how can they forbid tea merchants?"

sentences.zh: 聽其自如，訖無警。

translations.literal: Allowed them free as before, finally no alarm.
translations.idiomatic: He allowed them to come and go freely, and in the end there was no alarm.

sentences.zh: 累表乞閑，提舉興國宮。

translations.literal: Repeated memorials begged leisure, superintendent Xingguo Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly submitted memorials requesting leisure and was appointed superintendent of the Xingguo Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋，明堂大禮成，以其首議，復除敷文閣待制。

translations.literal: Autumn, Bright Hall great rite completed, because his first proposal, again removed as Fuwen Hall attendant draft.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, when the great Bright Hall rite was completed, he was again appointed attendant draft at the Hall of Diffusing Culture because of his original proposal.

sentences.zh: 頃之，垕、塾繼亡，上欲以吏事紓燾憂，起知遂寧府。

translations.literal: Soon after, Hou, Shu successively died, emperor wished with administrative affairs relieve Tao's grief, recalled to know Suining prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Hou and Shu died in succession; the emperor wished to relieve Tao's grief with administrative duties and recalled him to serve as prefect of Suining.

sentences.zh: 七年，《長編》全書成，上之，詔藏秘閣。

translations.literal: Seventh year, "Extended Compilation" complete book finished, submitted it, edict stored in Secret Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the complete Extended Compilation was finished; he submitted it and an edict ordered it stored in the Secret Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 燾自謂此書寧失之繁，無失之略，故一祖八宗之事凡九百七十八卷，卷第總目五卷。

translations.literal: Tao himself said this book rather lose in prolixity, not lose in brevity, therefore one founder eight emperors affairs in all nine hundred seventy-eight juan, juan index general catalog five juan.
translations.idiomatic: Tao himself said that this book might err on the side of prolixity but would not err on the side of brevity; therefore the affairs of one founder and eight emperors ran to nine hundred seventy-eight juan, with five juan of general catalog by juan.

sentences.zh: 依熙寧修《三經》例，損益修換四千四百餘事，上謂其書無愧司馬遷。

translations.literal: Following Xining revision "Three Classics" example, added subtracted revised replaced over four thousand four hundred items, emperor said its book not ashamed before Sima Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Following the example of the Xining revision of the Three Classics, he added, subtracted, revised, and replaced more than four thousand four hundred items; the emperor said the book was not unworthy before Sima Qian.

sentences.zh: 燾嘗舉漢石渠、白虎故事，請上稱制臨決，又請冠序，上許之，竟不克就。

translations.literal: Tao once cited Han Shiqu, White Tiger precedents, requested emperor by imperial decree personally decide, again requested preface at head, emperor permitted it, finally not able accomplish.
translations.idiomatic: Tao once cited the Han precedents of the Shiqu and White Tiger conferences, requested that the emperor personally decide by imperial decree, and again requested a preface at the head; the emperor permitted this, but it was finally not accomplished.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「陛下即位二十餘年，志在富強，而兵弱財匱，與『教民七年可以即戎者』異矣。」

translations.literal: Again memorialized: "Your Majesty ascended throne over twenty years, intent on enrichment and strength, yet troops weak treasury exhausted, with 'teach people seven years can then take up arms' different."
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized: "Your Majesty has been on the throne for more than twenty years with intent toward enrichment and strength, yet the troops are weak and the treasury exhausted—this differs from 'teach the people for seven years and they can take up arms.'

sentences.zh: 一日，召對延和殿，講臣方讀《陸贄奏議》，燾因言：「贄雖相德宗，其實不遇。

translations.literal: One day, summoned for audience at Yanhe Hall, lecturers just reading "Lu Zhi Memorials," Tao thereupon said: "Zhi though served as minister to Dezong, in fact not met with favor.
translations.idiomatic: One day he was summoned for an audience at the Yanhe Hall while the lecturers were reading Lu Zhi's Memorials; Tao thereupon said, "Though Zhi served as minister to Dezong, in fact he was not met with favor.

sentences.zh: 今遇陛下，可謂千載一時。」

translations.literal: Now meeting Your Majesty, can be called thousand-year one time."
translations.idiomatic: Now meeting Your Majesty can be called a once-in-a-thousand-years moment."

sentences.zh: 遂舉贄所言切於今可舉而行者數十事，勸上力行之。

translations.literal: Thereupon cited Zhi's words cutting to present and practicable several tens of items, urged emperor forcefully carry them out.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he cited several tens of items from what Zhi said that cut to the present and could be practised, urging the emperor to carry them out forcefully.

sentences.zh: 上有功業不足之歎，燾曰：「功業見乎變通，人事既修，天應乃至。」

translations.literal: Emperor had sigh that merit insufficient, Tao said: "Merit appears in adaptation, human affairs already cultivated, heaven's response then arrives."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sighed that his merit was insufficient. Tao said, "Merit appears in adaptation; once human affairs are cultivated, heaven's response then arrives."

sentences.zh: 進敷文閣直學士，提舉佑神觀兼侍講、同修國史。

translations.literal: Advanced Fuwen Hall direct academician, superintendent Youshen Abbey concurrently lecturer, concurrent compiler of National History.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to direct academician at the Hall of Diffusing Culture, superintendent of the Youshen Abbey while concurrently lecturer and concurrent compiler of the National History.

sentences.zh: 薦尤袤、劉清之十人為史官。

translations.literal: Recommended You Mao, Liu Qingzhi ten men as historiographers.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended ten men including You Mao and Liu Qingzhi as historiographers.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，久旱，進祖宗避殿減膳求言故事，上亟施行。

translations.literal: Tenth year seventh month, long drought, submitted ancestors' precedents of avoiding hall reducing meals seeking words, emperor urgently carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year, after a long drought, he submitted the ancestors' precedents of avoiding the hall, reducing meals, and seeking remonstrance; the emperor urgently carried these out.

sentences.zh: 丁丑雨。

translations.literal: Dingchou day rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day it rained.

sentences.zh: 一日宣對，燾言：「外議陛下多服藥，罕御殿，宮嬪無時進見，浮費頗多。」

translations.literal: One day announced audience, Tao said: "Outside discussion Your Majesty much takes medicine, rarely attends hall, palace consorts without fixed time received, wasteful expenses quite many."
translations.idiomatic: One day at an announced audience Tao said, "Outside there is talk that Your Majesty takes much medicine, rarely attends court, receives palace consorts at no fixed times, and has quite many wasteful expenses."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿可謂忠愛，顧朕老矣，安得此聲。

translations.literal: Emperor said: "You can be called loyal and loving, but We are old, how obtain this reputation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You can be called loyal and loving, but We are old—how could We obtain this reputation?

sentences.zh: 近惟葬李婕妤用三萬緡，他無費也。」

translations.literal: Recently only burying Lady Li used thirty thousand strings, other no expense."
translations.idiomatic: Recently only the burial of Lady Li used thirty thousand strings; there were no other expenses."

sentences.zh: 遂因轉對，乞用祖宗故事召宰執赴經筵。

translations.literal: Thereupon through rotating audience, begged use ancestors' precedents summon chief ministers to classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, through a rotating audience, he begged to use the ancestors' precedents in summoning the chief ministers to the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 太史言十一月朔，日當食心八分。

translations.literal: Grand Astrologer said eleventh month first day, sun ought eclipse heart eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: The grand astrologer said that on the first day of the eleventh month the sun would eclipse eight parts of the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 燾復條上古今日食是月者三十四事，因奏之曰：「心，天王位，其分為宋。

translations.literal: Tao again itemized ancient and present solar eclipses in this month thirty-four cases, thereupon memorialized said: "Heart, Heavenly King's position, its allotment is Song.
translations.idiomatic: Tao again itemized thirty-four cases of ancient and present solar eclipses in this month and memorialized, saying, "The Heart is the Heavenly King's position, and its allotment is Song.

sentences.zh: 十一月于卦為復，方潛陽時，陰氣乘之，故比他食為重，非小人害政，即敵人窺中國。」

translations.literal: Eleventh month in hexagram is Return, just hidden yang time, yin force rides it, therefore heavier than other eclipses, either petty men harm government, or enemy spies on Middle Kingdom."
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month in the hexagrams is Return, when yang is just hidden and yin force rides upon it; therefore this eclipse is heavier than others—either petty men are harming government or enemies are spying on the Middle Kingdom."

sentences.zh: 明日對延和殿，又及晉何曾譏武帝無經國遠圖。

translations.literal: Next day audience at Yanhe Hall, again reached Jin He Zeng mocking Emperor Wu lacking state-governing far plan.
translations.idiomatic: The next day at an audience in the Yanhe Hall he again reached He Zeng of Jin mocking Emperor Wu for lacking a far-reaching plan for governing the state.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，乞致仕，優詔不允。

translations.literal: Eleventh year spring, begged retire from office, gracious edict not permit.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year he begged to retire from office, but a gracious edict did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 上數問其疾增損，給事中宇文价傳上旨，燾曰：「臣子戀闕，非老病，忍乞骸骨。」

translations.literal: Emperor repeatedly asked his illness increase or decrease, Supervising Secretary Yuwen Jia transmitted emperor's intent, Tao said: "Subject loyal to court, not old illness, how bear beg bones."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor repeatedly asked after the increase or decrease of his illness; the supervising secretary Yuwen Jia transmitted the emperor's intent. Tao said, "A subject is loyal to the court; unless old or ill, how can one bear to beg to leave one's bones?"

sentences.zh: 因叩价時事，勉以忠藎。

translations.literal: Thereupon asked Jia current affairs, urged with loyal devotion.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he asked Jia about current affairs and urged him to loyal devotion.

sentences.zh: 又聞四川乞減酒課額，猶手劄贊廟堂行之。

translations.literal: Again heard Sichuan begged reduce wine tax quota, still by hand note praised court carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: When he again heard that Sichuan had requested reduction of the wine tax quota, he still by hand note praised the court for carrying it out.

sentences.zh: 病革，除敷文閣學士，致仕。

translations.literal: Illness critical, removed as Fuwen Hall academician, retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness turned critical he was appointed academician at the Hall of Diffusing Culture and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 命下，喜曰：「事了矣。」

translations.literal: Order issued, pleased said: "Affair finished."
translations.idiomatic: When the order was issued he said with pleasure, "The affair is finished."

sentences.zh: 口占遺表云：「臣年七十，死不為夭，所恨報國缺然。

translations.literal: Orally composed death memorial said: "Subject age seventy, death not premature, regret serving state insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: He orally composed a death memorial saying, "Your subject is seventy; death is not premature, but I regret that service to the state has been insufficient.

sentences.zh: 願陛下經遠以藝祖為師，用人以昭陵為則。」

translations.literal: Wish Your Majesty govern far taking Art Ancestor as teacher, employ men taking Zhaoling as rule."
translations.idiomatic: I wish that Your Majesty would govern with far-reaching vision taking the Art Ancestor as teacher and employ men taking the Zhaoling reign as the rule."

sentences.zh: 辭氣舒徐，乃卒，年七十。

translations.literal: Words and breath calm and slow, then died, age seventy.
translations.idiomatic: His words and breath were calm and unhurried, and then he died, at the age of seventy.

sentences.zh: 上聞嗟悼，贈光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Emperor heard sighed and mourned, posthumously granted Guanglu Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard he sighed and mourned, and posthumously granted him the title of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 他日謂宇文价曰：「朕嘗許燾大書『續資治通鑒長編』七字，且用神宗賜司馬光故事，為序冠篇，不謂其止此。」

translations.literal: Another day told Yuwen Jia said: "We once promised Tao large writing 'Continuation Comprehensive Mirror Extended Compilation' seven characters, and use Shenzong's grant to Sima Guang precedent, make preface crown the work, did not expect it ends here."
translations.idiomatic: Another day he told Yuwen Jia, "We once promised Tao large writing of the seven characters 'Continuation Comprehensive Mirror Extended Compilation,' and to use the precedent of Shenzong's grant to Sima Guang in making a preface crown the work—we did not expect it would end here."

sentences.zh: 燾性剛大，特立獨行。

translations.literal: Tao nature firm and great, stood alone walked alone.
translations.idiomatic: Tao's nature was firm and great; he stood and walked alone.

sentences.zh: 早著書，檜尚當路，檜死始聞於朝。

translations.literal: Early wrote books, Hui still held power, Hui died then heard at court.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote books early; Hui still held power, and only after Hui died was he heard of at court.

sentences.zh: 暨在從列，每正色以訂國論。

translations.literal: When in attendant ranks, each time stern countenance to correct state discussion.
translations.idiomatic: When he was in the attendant ranks he each time with stern countenance corrected state discussion.

sentences.zh: 張栻嘗曰：「李仁甫如霜松雪柏。

translations.literal: Zhang Shi once said: "Li Renfu like frost pine snow cypress.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi once said, "Li Renfu is like a frost pine or snow cypress.

sentences.zh: 無嗜好，無姬侍，不殖產。

translations.literal: No hobbies, no concubine attendants, not accumulate estates.
translations.idiomatic: He had no hobbies, no concubine attendants, and did not accumulate estates.

sentences.zh: 平生生死文字間。」

translations.literal: Whole life lived and died among written words."
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his life he lived and died among written words."

sentences.zh: 《長編》一書用力四十年，葉適以為《春秋》以後才有此書。

translations.literal: "Extended Compilation" one book exerted effort forty years, Ye Shi thought since "Spring and Autumn" only then had this book.
translations.idiomatic: The Extended Compilation was the work of forty years; Ye Shi thought that only since the Spring and Autumn Annals had there been such a book.

sentences.zh: 有《易學》五卷，《春秋學》十卷，《五學傳授》、《尚書百篇圖》、《大傳雜說》、《七十二子名籍》各一卷，《文集》五十卷，《奏議》三十卷，《四朝史稿》五十卷，《通論》十一卷，《南北攻守錄》三十卷，《七十二候圖》、《陶潛新傳》並《詩譜》各三卷，《歷代宰相年表》、《唐宰相譜》、《江左方鎮年表》、《晉司馬氏本支》、《齊梁本支》、《王謝世表》、《五代將帥年表》合為四十一卷。

translations.literal: Had "Changes Learning" five juan, "Spring and Autumn Learning" ten juan, "Five Learning Transmission," "Documents Hundred Chapters Chart," "Great Tradition Miscellaneous Discussions," "Seventy-Two Disciples Name Registers" each one juan, "Collected Works" fifty juan, "Memorials" thirty juan, "Four Dynasties History Draft" fifty juan, "General Discussions" eleven juan, "North-South Attack and Defense Record" thirty juan, "Seventy-Two Seasonal Nodes Chart," "Tao Qian New Biography" and "Poetry Genealogy" each three juan, "Successive Dynasties Chief Ministers Year Table," "Tang Chief Ministers Genealogy," "Jiangzuo Regional Command Year Table," "Jin Sima Clan Branch," "Qi-Liang Branch," "Wang-Xie Clan Table," "Five Dynasties Generals Year Table" together forty-one juan.
translations.idiomatic: He had Changes Learning in five juan, Spring and Autumn Learning in ten juan, Five Learning Transmission, Documents Hundred Chapters Chart, Great Tradition Miscellaneous Discussions, and Seventy-Two Disciples Name Registers each in one juan, Collected Works in fifty juan, Memorials in thirty juan, Four Dynasties History Draft in fifty juan, General Discussions in eleven juan, North-South Attack and Defense Record in thirty juan, Seventy-Two Seasonal Nodes Chart, Tao Qian New Biography, and Poetry Genealogy each in three juan, and Successive Dynasties Chief Ministers Year Table, Tang Chief Ministers Genealogy, Jiangzuo Regional Command Year Table, Jin Sima Clan Branch, Qi-Liang Branch, Wang-Xie Clan Table, and Five Dynasties Generals Year Table together in forty-one juan.

sentences.zh: 諡「文簡」，累贈太師、溫國公。

translations.literal: Posthumous title "Wenjian," repeatedly posthumously granted Grand Preceptor, Duke of Wen.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Wenjian and was repeatedly posthumously granted the titles of grand preceptor and Duke of Wen.

sentences.zh: 子垕、𡉙、塾、壁、𡌴。

translations.literal: Sons Hou, 𡉙, Shu, Bi, 𡌴.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Hou, 𡉙, Shu, Bi, and 𡌴.

sentences.zh: 垕，著作郎；

translations.literal: Hou, Compiler;
translations.idiomatic: Hou served as compiler;

sentences.zh: 𡉙，夔州路提點刑獄；

translations.literal: 𡉙, Kuizhou circuit intendant of punishments;
translations.idiomatic: 𡉙 served as intendant of punishments on the Kuizhou circuit;

sentences.zh: 壁、𡌴皆執政，別有傳。

translations.literal: Bi, 𡌴 all held chief minister posts, separately have biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Bi and 𡌴 both held chief minister posts and have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 論曰：執羔宿德雅度，在經筵，忠忱啟沃，以口舌相高為戒。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Zhigao long virtue and elegant bearing, at classics lecture, loyal devotion nourished the ruler, took competing in eloquence as warning.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Zhigao had long-standing virtue and an elegant bearing; at the classics lecture he nourished the ruler with loyal devotion and took competing in eloquence as a thing to be warned against.

sentences.zh: 希呂剛直懇切，有古引裾風。

translations.literal: Xilu firm and upright earnest, had ancient pull-hem wind.
translations.idiomatic: Xilu was firm, upright, and earnest, with the bearing of the ancients who pulled at the emperor's hem to remonstrate.

sentences.zh: 良佑力止泛使，懼開釁端，忤旨竄斥而甘心焉。

translations.literal: Liangyou forcefully stopped general envoys, feared opening breach beginning, opposed imperial intent banished yet willingly accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Liangyou forcefully stopped general envoys, fearing the opening of a breach; though banished for opposing the imperial intent, he accepted it willingly.

sentences.zh: 李浩獨不造秦熺，陳橐以呈身為恥，文若譏休兵，胡沂斥閹宦，其清風苦節，終始弗渝。

translations.literal: Li Hao alone not visited Qin Xi, Chen Tuo took presenting oneself as shame, Wenruo mocked ceasing troops, Hu Yi expelled eunuch officials, their pure wind and bitter integrity, from beginning to end not changed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hao alone did not visit Qin Xi; Chen Tuo took presenting oneself as shameful; Wenruo mocked ceasing military action; Hu Yi expelled eunuch officials—their pure bearing and bitter integrity never changed from beginning to end.

sentences.zh: 高、孝之世，李燾恥讀王氏書，掇拾禮文殘缺之餘，粲然有則，《長編》之作，咸稱史才，然所掇拾，或出野史，《春秋》傳疑傳信之法然歟！

translations.literal: Gaozong, Xiaozong age, Li Tao ashamed read Wang clan books, gathered ritual texts' broken remnants, brilliantly had rules, "Extended Compilation" composition, all called historiographic talent, yet what gathered sometimes from unofficial histories, "Spring and Autumn" transmit doubt transmit trust method perhaps!
translations.idiomatic: In the age of Gaozong and Xiaozong, Li Tao was ashamed to read the books of the Wang clan; he gathered what remained of broken ritual texts and brilliantly established rules. The composition of the Extended Compilation was universally praised as historiographic talent, yet what he gathered sometimes came from unofficial histories—is this perhaps the method of the Spring and Autumn Annals in transmitting what is doubtful and what is trustworthy!
